element_type.description: Represents the structural element type of this entry in the layout, distinguishing standard data fields from mirror fields. Possible values: `field` — a standard data field that accepts or displays a value. `mirror_field` — a field that reflects a value from a related module through a lookup relationship.

enable_record_category.description: Indicates if the record category feature is enabled for this picklist field. Only returned when the record category feature is available.

oneOf.description: Field reference for tracking record category changes.

record_category_tracking_field.description: Reference to the field used to track record category changes over time in the timeline view. Only present when enable_record_category is true and a tracking field is configured.

enable_transition_for_record_category.description: Indicates if transitions between record categories are enabled. Only returned when enable_record_category is true.

value.description: Display value of the record category.

nature_of_category.description: Nature of the record category indicating sentiment or outcome.

items.description: Individual record category configuration.

record_category_values.description: List of record category values defined for this picklist field. Only returned when enable_record_category is true.

lookup_field.description: Represents the source lookup field on which a mirror field is based, identifying the cross-module lookup relationship from which this field's value is derived.

FieldSchema.description: Represents a comprehensive schema for a CRM field in a module layout, encapsulating all field-level configuration including data type, display settings, permissions, lookup relationships, formula definitions, and audit metadata.

name.description: Represents the name of the CRM profile that is permitted to view the unmasked field value, identifying which user group is exempt from the field's masking rules.

MaskDetailsProfile.description: Represents a CRM profile that is permitted to view the unmasked value of a masked field, exempting users of this profile from the field's masking rules.

name.description: Represents the internal API name of the layout.

display_label.description: Represents the display label of the layout shown in the CRM interface.

oneOf.description: ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset indicating when the layout was created.
ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset indicating when the layout was last modified.

status.description: Represents the current status of the layout.

visible.description: Indicates whether the layout is visible to users in the CRM interface.

show_business_card.description: Indicates whether the business card view is enabled for this layout.

generated_type.description: Indicates whether the layout was generated by the system or created by a user.

source.description: Represents the source from which this layout was created.

items.description: Represents an individual layout carrying only the keys requested through the `fields` parameter, plus the always-present `id`.

layouts.description: Represents the array of layout objects trimmed to the keys requested through the `fields` parameter, ordered by layout name.

LayoutFieldsResponseSchema.description: Represents the response returned when the `fields` query parameter trims each layout to the requested keys. Only `id` is guaranteed - it is returned even when it is not requested - every other key appears only when it was asked for, and keys with no value for a layout are returned as null.

has_more_profiles.description: Indicates whether additional profile associations exist for this layout beyond those included in the current response. Possible values: `true` — more profile associations are available; `false` — all profile associations are represented.

oneOf.description: Represents the ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset recording when this layout was first created in the CRM.

visible.description: Indicates whether this layout is currently visible and accessible to users in the CRM interface. Possible values: `true` — the layout is visible and selectable; `false` — the layout is hidden.

oneOf.description: Represents the integration or system context that prompted the creation of this layout, identifying the source platform or feature responsible for provisioning it.

default.description: Indicates whether this layout is the default for the associated portal user type. Possible values: `true` — this is the default layout for this portal user type; `false` — it is not the default.

name.description: Represents the name of the portal user type associated with this layout entry.
Represents the API name of the default view assigned to this portal user type.

type.description: Indicates the category of the default view assigned to this portal user type, such as a layout view or a wizard-based view.

_default_view.description: Represents the default view assigned to this portal user type for the layout, defining which view is presented to portal users of this type by default.

items.description: Represents the portal user type configuration entry for this layout, specifying the user type, default view settings, and whether this is the default layout for that user type.

portal_user_types.description: Contains the list of portal user type associations for this layout, each specifying which portal user category the layout is associated with and the default view configuration for that user type.

oneOf.description: Represents the list of CRM profiles associated with this layout. Contains an empty array when no profiles are assigned.

source.description: Represents the origin channel of this layout. Possible values: `crm` — the layout is built into the standard module definition. `platform_plugin` — the layout comes from a Zoho platform plugin. `marketplace_plugin` — the layout comes from a Marketplace extension. `campaign_integration` — the layout comes from a Campaigns integration.

isSubformSection.description: Indicates whether this section renders as an embedded subform that displays related module records inline within the parent record's layout. Possible values: `true` — the section is a subform; `false` — the section is a standard field group.

name.description: Represents the name of the parent section under which this nested section is organized within the layout.

oneOf.description: Represents the parent section reference for a nested section, identifying the containing parent section by name when a hierarchical section relationship exists.

parent_section.description: Represents a reference to the parent section when this section is nested as a subform or dependent section within the layout hierarchy.

type.description: Represents the usage status type of this section within the layout. Possible values: `used` — the section contains fields assigned to it. `unused` — the section exists in the layout but contains no assigned fields.

display_label.description: Represents the name of the section as displayed in the CRM interface, used as the section heading on record create and detail pages.

mode.description: Represents the layout mode for which this section applies, controlling in which view contexts the section and its fields render. Possible values: `all` — applies across all layout modes. `business_card` — applies to the business card view. `quick_create` — applies to the quick-create form. `default_create` — applies to the default record creation form. `create_edit` — applies to both create and edit forms. `view` — applies to the record detail view. `quick_view` — applies to the quick view panel. `subform_default_create` — applies to the default create form within a subform context.

sequence_number.description: Represents the ordinal position of this section within the layout, controlling the order in which sections are rendered on record forms.

tab_traversal.description: Indicates the direction of keyboard tab navigation within this section, determining the order in which focus moves between fields when users press Tab. Possible values: `left_to_right` — focus moves horizontally across columns first. `top_to_bottom` — focus moves vertically down each column first.

column_count.description: Indicates the number of columns in which fields are arranged within this section, controlling the side-by-side or single-column display of fields on record forms.

is_parent_section.description: Indicates whether this section acts as the parent container for a dependent subform section, establishing a hierarchical section relationship within the layout. Possible values: `true` — this is a parent section; `false` — this section is not a parent container.

name.description: Represents the internal name of the section used to reference it in layout configurations and API operations.

generated_type.description: Indicates whether this section originates from automatic system generation or from an administrator's manual configuration. Possible values: `default` — automatically generated by the CRM platform. `custom` — defined manually by an administrator.

fields.description: Contains the ordered list of fields assigned to this section. Fields are presented in ascending sequence_number order.

items.description: Represents a single section within the layout, encapsulating the section's field collection, display label, column configuration, and any subform or parent-section relationships.

sections.description: Contains the ordered list of sections within this layout, each grouping a set of fields and defining display properties such as column count and tab traversal order.

display_label.description: Represents the label of the layout as displayed in the CRM interface, shown in layout selection dropdowns and record settings.

show_business_card.description: Indicates whether the business card view is enabled for this layout, allowing a compact summary of key fields to be shown in preview and lookup contexts. Possible values: `true` — business card view is active; `false` — business card view is not enabled.

oneOf.description: Represents the ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset recording when this layout's configuration was most recently changed.

name.description: Represents the internal API name of the layout, used as a programmatic identifier in API operations and automation configurations.

generated_type.description: Indicates whether this layout originates from automatic system generation or from an administrator's manual configuration. Possible values: `system` — automatically generated by Zoho CRM. `custom` — created manually by an administrator.

total_profiles.description: Indicates the total number of CRM profiles associated with this layout, which may exceed the number of profiles included in the current response when has_more_profiles is true.

status.description: Indicates the current operational status of the layout. Possible values: `active` — the layout is in use and can be assigned to profiles; `inactive` — the layout has been deactivated and is not available for new assignments.

items.description: Represents the complete configuration of a single layout in the module, including its sections, field assignments, profile associations, and display metadata.

layouts.description: Contains the array of layout objects returned for the specified module, each representing a complete layout configuration including sections, fields, profiles, and portal user type associations.

code.description: Identifies the category of error returned by the API. id.description: Specify the unique identifier of the deactivated layout to activate. Must reference an existing deactivated layout within the specified module. The ID is represented as a string containing a 64-bit integer value. Layout IDs are data center-specific. The status key in the response from the [Get Layouts Metadata API](layouts.yaml#$.paths./settings/layouts.get) indicates whether the layout is **active** or **inactive**.

Specify the unique identifier of the profile to associate with or disassociate from the layout. Must be a profile that exists in the CRM organization and is associated with the specified module. The ID is represented as a string containing a 64-bit integer value. Refer to the [Get Profiles](profiles.yaml#$.paths./settings/profiles.get) resource for valid values.

_delete.description: Specify whether to remove this profile's association from the layout. Possible values: **true** - Removes the profile association from the layout. **false** - Adds or retains the profile association on the layout.

items.description: Specify a profile to associate with or disassociate from the layout.

profiles.description: Specify the profile associations to add to or remove from the layout during activation. Omitting this field or providing an empty array preserves existing profile associations. Refer to the [Get Profiles](profiles.yaml#$.paths./settings/profiles.get) resource for valid values. Use the _delete flag to remove existing associations. Empty array or omitting this field entirely preserves existing profile associations. At least one profile must remain associated with the layout after all operations are applied. While duplicate profile IDs are technically allowed, they cause unnecessary processing and should be avoided.

duplicate_check_fields.description:
Specifies the fields used to check for duplicate records during an Upsert operation. Duplicate check fields can be system-defined unique fields or user-defined unique fields.  
The following are the system-defined duplicate check fields for the respective modules: Leads - "Email"; Accounts - "Account_Name"; Contacts - "Email"; Deals - "Deal_Name"; Campaigns - "Campaign_Name"; Cases - "Subject"; Solutions - "Solution_Title"; Products - "Product_Name"; Vendors - "Vendor_Name"; PriceBooks - "Price_Book_Name"; Quotes - "Subject"; SalesOrders - "Subject"; PurchaseOrders - "Subject"; Invoices - "Subject"; Custom Modules - "Name".
If a matching record is found based on these fields, the record is updated; otherwise, a new record is inserted.

lar_id.description: The unique ID of the assignment rule to trigger while inserting a record. Use the Get Assignment Rules API to retrieve valid values. This key must be provided parallel to the data key. Supported for all modules where assignment rules are applicable, such as Leads, Contacts, Deals, Accounts, Tasks, Cases, and Custom.

Specify "layout_rules" to apply layout rules or "criteria_validation_rule" to trigger validation rules. For "layout_rules", ensure the request includes all fields required by the layout rule criteria; otherwise, the API returns an error. For "criteria_validation_rule", all applicable validation rules are evaluated, and the API returns "MULTIPLE_OR_MULTI_ERRORS" if multiple rules fail.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the field used for filter operations.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field used for filter application. Supports relationship notation, for example, Deals__r.Stage.

record_FilterFieldBase.description: Represents the base field reference used in filter operations, containing minimal required properties. The field's data_type is not part of this object; resolve it from the corresponding FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

record_SimpleFilterCriterionValueString.description: Represents a string filter criterion value applicable to fields with a data_type of text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime, as well as any data_type not explicitly covered by SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber, SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean, SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectResponse, or the multiselect lookup value schemas.

record_SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber.description: Represents a numeric filter criterion value applicable to fields with a data_type of integer, currency, or double.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the lookup module record.

name.description: Represents the display name of the lookup module record.

record_SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectB.description: Represents the base minified record structure of a lookup module, containing the record's unique identifier and display name.

allOf.description: Represents the constraint that the ID property is required for the lookup object filter criterion value in request bodies.

record_SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectR.description: Represents a lookup object filter criterion value for request bodies, applicable when the field's data_type is lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup. The ID property is required.

name.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the currently logged-in user.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSER} - Represents the currently logged-in user.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user, in which only the name property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property is included.

id.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the logged-in user's role record ID.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSERROLE} - Represents the role of the currently logged-in user.

name.description: Represents an optional display label for the predefined role, such as Logged in User Role.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user's role, in which the ID property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and the name property is an optional display label.

record_SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectP.description: Represents a predefined placeholder object filter criterion value for lookup fields, applicable with equal or not_equal comparators when the field's data_type is ownerlookup or userlookup. Two forms are supported: (1) the currently logged-in user, represented by passing only the name property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property; and (2) the logged-in user's role, represented by passing the ID property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and an optional display label in the name property. For specific real users or roles that are not predefined, use SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, which requires the ID property.

record_SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean.description: Represents a Boolean filter criterion value. Applicable only when the field has a Boolean data type (checkbox field).

record_SimpleFilterCriterionValueGeneral.description:
Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable to any field data_type with the equal comparator.
Possible values:
${EMPTY} - Matches records where the field has no value.
${NOTEMPTY} - Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the field has no value (null or empty string).
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

record_SimpleFilterCriterionValueDateTim.description: Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator.

x-enumDescriptions.${TODAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the current calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROW}: Matches records where the date field falls on the next calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROWPLUS}: Matches records where the date field is on tomorrow or any later date (tomorrow onwards).
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the previous calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAYMINUS}: Matches records where the date field is on yesterday or any earlier date (up to and including yesterday).
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the entire previous calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar week (Monday–Sunday).
x-enumDescriptions.${THISWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has no value set.
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has a value set.

record_SimpleFilterCriterionValueNDaysPr.description: Represents a predefined N-period range placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator. Follows the pattern ${NEXT_N_<PERIOD>:<n>} or ${LAST_N_<PERIOD>:<n>}, where PERIOD is DAYS, WEEKS, MONTHS, or YEARS and n is a positive integer. The current period is always excluded from the range.

record_SimpleFilterCriterionValueAgeDueP.description: Represents a predefined age or due-in-days placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime. Follows the pattern ${AGEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field was exactly n days in the past, or ${DUEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field is exactly n days in the future. Supported comparators are equal, not_equal, less_than, greater_than, less_equal, and greater_equal.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
equal - Matches records where the field value equals the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

record_EqualFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders. Accepts scalar or array values. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the not-equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the not-equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the not-equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
not_equal - Matches records where the field value does not equal the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the not_equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the not_equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

record_NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the not_equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

record_EqualityFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionRequest or NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest schema based on the comparator value.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the text filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the text filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the text comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
like - Matches records where the field value contains the specified pattern.
not_like - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified pattern.
starts_with - Matches records where the field value begins with the specified string.
ends_with - Matches records where the field value ends with the specified string.
contains - Matches records where the field value contains the specified string.
not_contains - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified string.

oneOf.description: Contains an array of primitive string values for the text filter comparator.

value.description: Represents the string filter value used in the text comparator. Accepts a scalar string or an array of string values.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

record_TextFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value must be a string scalar or array; use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based field types. Object and Boolean values are not supported. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the ordering filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the ordering filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the ordering comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
less_than - Matches records where the field value is less than the specified filter value.
less_equal - Matches records where the field value is less than or equal to the specified filter value.
greater_than - Matches records where the field value is greater than the specified filter value.
greater_equal - Matches records where the field value is greater than or equal to the specified filter value.

value.description: Represents the scalar filter value used in the ordering comparator. Arrays and objects are not supported for ordering comparators.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

record_OrderingFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the less_than, less_equal, greater_than, and greater_equal comparators. The value must be a scalar; arrays and objects are not supported. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the range filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the range filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the range comparison operator applied to the criterion, indicating whether the field value falls within or outside the specified bounds.
Possible values:
between - Matches records where the field value falls within the specified range.
not_between - Matches records where the field value falls outside the specified range.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field is evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

record_BetweenFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the between and not_between comparators. The value must be an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the set filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the set filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the set membership comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
in - Matches records where the field value is in the specified set of values.
not_in - Matches records where the field value is not in the specified set of values.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values used in the set comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

record_SetFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the in and not_in comparators. The value must be an array of primitive values. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based types, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the multi-select lookup filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the multi-select lookup filter criterion is applied. The field must have a data_type of multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

comparator.description:
Represents the multi-select lookup comparison operator applied to the criterion. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.
Possible values:
include_all - Matches records that include all specified lookup values.
include_any - Matches records that include at least one of the specified lookup values.
exclude_all - Matches records that exclude all specified lookup values.
exclude_any - Matches records that exclude at least one of the specified lookup values.

value.description: Contains an array of lookup object references used in the multi-select comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

record_MultiSelectLookupFilterCriterionR.description: Represents a filter criterion for the include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup. The value must be an array of SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest lookup objects.

record_SimpleFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a simple field-based filter criterion that dispatches to the appropriate comparator-specific schema. The equal and not_equal comparators support scalar or array values; text comparators support scalar or array strings; ordering comparators require a scalar; between and not_between comparators require a two-element array; in and not_in comparators require an array of primitives; and include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators require an array of lookup objects and apply only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

group_operator.description:
Represents the logical operator applied between the filter conditions in the group.
Possible values:
AND - All conditions in the group must be satisfied.
OR - At least one condition in the group must be satisfied.
and - Equivalent to AND; all conditions in the group must be satisfied.
or - Equivalent to OR; at least one condition in the group must be satisfied.

record_GroupedFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a grouped filter criterion containing multiple filter conditions evaluated with a logical operator. Supports recursive nesting for complex filtering logic.

record_FilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents the top-level filter criterion for data selection, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the child relationship module used to identify the relationship.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the child relationship module record.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the related module relationship referenced by this criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an unresolvable or deleted relationship definition.

record_ChildRelationshipReference.description: Represents the reference to a child relationship module. The api_name property is required to identify the child relationship.

include_objects.description: Indicates whether records with matching related records are included in the results.

items.description: Represents a single cross-filter object that filters records based on the presence or absence of related module records matching the specified criteria.

record_CrossFiltersRequest.description: Represents a list of cross-filter objects that filter Custom View records based on related module records' criteria.

code.description: Represents the unique error code that identifies the type of failure.

message.description: Represents the error message describing the reason for the failure.

details.description: Represents additional details about the error, which may include the field API name or parameter name associated with the failure.

status.description:
Indicates the response status. Possible values:
**error** - The request resulted in an error.

record_count_ErrorResponse.description: Represents a standard error response returned by the Zoho CRM API when a request fails.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the field used for filter operations.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field used for filter application. Supports relationship notation, for example, Deals__r.Stage.

record_count_FilterFieldBase.description: Represents the base field reference used in filter operations, containing minimal required properties. The field's data_type is not part of this object; resolve it from the corresponding FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

record_count_SimpleFilterCriterionValueS.description: Represents a string filter criterion value applicable to fields with a data_type of text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime, as well as any data_type not explicitly covered by SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber, SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean, SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectResponse, or the multiselect lookup value schemas.

record_count_SimpleFilterCriterionValueN.description: Represents a numeric filter criterion value applicable to fields with a data_type of integer, currency, or double.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the lookup module record.

name.description: Represents the display name of the lookup module record.

record_count_SimpleFilterCriterionValueO.description: Represents the base minified record structure of a lookup module, containing the record's unique identifier and display name.

allOf.description: Represents the constraint that the ID property is required for the lookup object filter criterion value in request bodies.

record_count_SimpleFilterCriterionValueO.description: Represents a lookup object filter criterion value for request bodies, applicable when the field's data_type is lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup. The ID property is required.

name.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the currently logged-in user.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSER} - Represents the currently logged-in user.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user, in which only the name property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property is included.

id.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the logged-in user's role record ID.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSERROLE} - Represents the role of the currently logged-in user.

name.description: Represents an optional display label for the predefined role, such as Logged in User Role.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user's role, in which the ID property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and the name property is an optional display label.

record_count_SimpleFilterCriterionValueO.description: Represents a predefined placeholder object filter criterion value for lookup fields, applicable with equal or not_equal comparators when the field's data_type is ownerlookup or userlookup. Two forms are supported: (1) the currently logged-in user, represented by passing only the name property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property; and (2) the logged-in user's role, represented by passing the ID property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and an optional display label in the name property. For specific real users or roles that are not predefined, use SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, which requires the ID property.

record_count_SimpleFilterCriterionValueB.description: Represents a Boolean filter criterion value. Applicable only when the field has a Boolean data type (checkbox field).

record_count_SimpleFilterCriterionValueG.description:
Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable to any field data_type with the equal comparator.
Possible values:
${EMPTY} - Matches records where the field has no value.
${NOTEMPTY} - Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the field has no value (null or empty string).
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

record_count_SimpleFilterCriterionValueD.description: Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator.

x-enumDescriptions.${TODAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the current calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROW}: Matches records where the date field falls on the next calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROWPLUS}: Matches records where the date field is on tomorrow or any later date (tomorrow onwards).
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the previous calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAYMINUS}: Matches records where the date field is on yesterday or any earlier date (up to and including yesterday).
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the entire previous calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar week (Monday–Sunday).
x-enumDescriptions.${THISWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has no value set.
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has a value set.

record_count_SimpleFilterCriterionValueN.description: Represents a predefined N-period range placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator. Follows the pattern ${NEXT_N_<PERIOD>:<n>} or ${LAST_N_<PERIOD>:<n>}, where PERIOD is DAYS, WEEKS, MONTHS, or YEARS and n is a positive integer. The current period is always excluded from the range.

record_count_SimpleFilterCriterionValueA.description: Represents a predefined age or due-in-days placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime. Follows the pattern ${AGEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field was exactly n days in the past, or ${DUEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field is exactly n days in the future. Supported comparators are equal, not_equal, less_than, greater_than, less_equal, and greater_equal.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
equal - Matches records where the field value equals the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

record_count_EqualFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders. Accepts scalar or array values. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the not-equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the not-equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the not-equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
not_equal - Matches records where the field value does not equal the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the not_equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the not_equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

record_count_NotEqualFilterCriterionRequ.description: Represents a filter criterion for the not_equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

record_count_EqualityFilterCriterionRequ.description: Represents an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionRequest or NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest schema based on the comparator value.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the text filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the text filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the text comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
like - Matches records where the field value contains the specified pattern.
not_like - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified pattern.
starts_with - Matches records where the field value begins with the specified string.
ends_with - Matches records where the field value ends with the specified string.
contains - Matches records where the field value contains the specified string.
not_contains - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified string.

oneOf.description: Contains an array of primitive string values for the text filter comparator.

value.description: Represents the string filter value used in the text comparator. Accepts a scalar string or an array of string values.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

record_count_TextFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value must be a string scalar or array; use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based field types. Object and Boolean values are not supported. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the ordering filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the ordering filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the ordering comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
less_than - Matches records where the field value is less than the specified filter value.
less_equal - Matches records where the field value is less than or equal to the specified filter value.
greater_than - Matches records where the field value is greater than the specified filter value.
greater_equal - Matches records where the field value is greater than or equal to the specified filter value.

value.description: Represents the scalar filter value used in the ordering comparator. Arrays and objects are not supported for ordering comparators.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

record_count_OrderingFilterCriterionRequ.description: Represents a filter criterion for the less_than, less_equal, greater_than, and greater_equal comparators. The value must be a scalar; arrays and objects are not supported. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the range filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the range filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the range comparison operator applied to the criterion, indicating whether the field value falls within or outside the specified bounds.
Possible values:
between - Matches records where the field value falls within the specified range.
not_between - Matches records where the field value falls outside the specified range.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field is evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

record_count_BetweenFilterCriterionReque.description: Represents a filter criterion for the between and not_between comparators. The value must be an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the set filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the set filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the set membership comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
in - Matches records where the field value is in the specified set of values.
not_in - Matches records where the field value is not in the specified set of values.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values used in the set comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

record_count_SetFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the in and not_in comparators. The value must be an array of primitive values. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based types, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the multi-select lookup filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the multi-select lookup filter criterion is applied. The field must have a data_type of multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

comparator.description:
Represents the multi-select lookup comparison operator applied to the criterion. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.
Possible values:
include_all - Matches records that include all specified lookup values.
include_any - Matches records that include at least one of the specified lookup values.
exclude_all - Matches records that exclude all specified lookup values.
exclude_any - Matches records that exclude at least one of the specified lookup values.

value.description: Contains an array of lookup object references used in the multi-select comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

record_count_MultiSelectLookupFilterCrit.description: Represents a filter criterion for the include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup. The value must be an array of SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest lookup objects.

record_count_SimpleFilterCriterionReques.description: Represents a simple field-based filter criterion that dispatches to the appropriate comparator-specific schema. The equal and not_equal comparators support scalar or array values; text comparators support scalar or array strings; ordering comparators require a scalar; between and not_between comparators require a two-element array; in and not_in comparators require an array of primitives; and include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators require an array of lookup objects and apply only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

group_operator.description:
Represents the logical operator applied between the filter conditions in the group.
Possible values:
AND - All conditions in the group must be satisfied.
OR - At least one condition in the group must be satisfied.
and - Equivalent to AND; all conditions in the group must be satisfied.
or - Equivalent to OR; at least one condition in the group must be satisfied.

record_count_GroupedFilterCriterionReque.description: Represents a grouped filter criterion containing multiple filter conditions evaluated with a logical operator. Supports recursive nesting for complex filtering logic.

record_count_FilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents the top-level filter criterion for data selection, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators.

RecordPhotoErrorDetailsEmpty.description: Represents an empty details object returned when no additional error context is available for the error response.

code.description: Result code indicating that the operation is scheduled. Possible values: **SCHEDULED**.

message.description: Represents the message confirming that the operation has been queued as a background job.

details.description: Represents additional details about the scheduled operation. This is typically an empty object or contains a record ID associated with the scheduled job.

status.description: Indicates that the request to schedule the operation succeeded. Possible values: **success**.

ScheduledResponse.description: Result returned when a recycle-bin operation is queued as a background job because it cannot complete synchronously.

status.description: Indicates that the per-item operation succeeded. Possible values: **success**.

code.description: Result code for the per-item operation. Possible values: **SUCCESS**.

message.description: Represents the message that describes the outcome of the per-item operation.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the recycle-bin record that the per-item result refers to.

details.description: Represents additional details about the per-item operation, including the affected record ID.

recycle_bin_SuccessResponse.description: Per-item result returned when a single recycle-bin record is processed successfully.

recycle_bin.description: List of per-item results for the operation. Each entry is either a success result or a scheduled-job result.

ResultList.description: Wrapper that returns the per-item results of a recycle-bin operation under the **recycle_bin** array.

status.description: Indicates that the API request failed. Possible values: **error**.

code.description: Error code identifying why the request failed. Possible values: **INVALID_DATA**, **EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING**, **EXPECTED_PARAM_MISSING**, **AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING**, **AUTHORIZATION_FAILED**.

message.description: Message that describes the cause of the error.

param_name.description: Represents the name of the request parameter that caused the error. Possible values: **filters**, **ids**.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field that caused the error.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path to the request body field that caused the error.

expected_data_type.description: Represents the data type expected for the offending field when the error is due to an invalid data type. Possible values: **jsonarray**, **jsonobject**, **string**.

items.description: Name of an expected request parameter that was not supplied. Possible values: **filters**, **ids**, **restore_all_records**.

param_names.description: List of request parameter names that are expected but missing when the error is **EXPECTED_PARAM_MISSING**.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the expected field.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path of the expected field within the request body.

items.description: Represents a single expected field, identified by its API name and JSON path.

expected_fields.description: List of fields that are expected in the request body when the error is **EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING**.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the ambiguity factor.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path of the ambiguity factor within the request body.

items.description: Represents a single ambiguity factor, identified by its API name and JSON path.

ambiguity_due_to.description: List of factors that caused ambiguity when the error is **AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING**, typically because two or more mutually exclusive restoration modes were supplied.

id.description: Represents the record identifier associated with the error.

resource_path_index.description: Represents the zero-based index of the resource path segment that caused the error.

details.description: Provides additional context about the error, such as the offending parameter, field, JSON path, expected data type, or record ID. The populated keys depend on the **code** value.

recycle_bin_ErrorResponse.description: Error payload returned when a recycle-bin request fails, including the error code, the error message, and context-specific details.

api_name.description: API name of the module associated with the related list.

id.description: Unique identifier of the module.

plural_label.description: Plural display label of the module.

RelatedListModule.description: Represents the module associated with a related list, including its API name and unique identifier.

id.description: Unique identifier of the field used for sorting.

api_name.description: API name of the field used for sorting.

RelatedListSortField.description: Represents the field used to sort records in a related list.

id.description: Unique identifier of the sort field.

api_name.description: API name of the field used for sorting. For multiselectlookup related lists, this is in the format ModuleName.FieldApiName (e.g., "Leads.Company").

RelatedListMultiselectSortField.description: Field metadata used for sorting a multiselectlookup related list. The api_name follows the format ModuleName.FieldApiName (e.g., "Leads.Company") where the left part is the connected module api_name and the right part is the field api_name.

sequence_number.description: Display order position of the field within the related list.

id.description: Unique identifier of the field.

api_name.description: API name of the field.

field_label.description: Display label of the field.

ui_type.description: UI type identifier that determines how the field is rendered.

enable_colour_code.description: Indicates whether color coding is enabled for this field. Possible values: **true**, **false**.

separator.description: Indicates whether a separator is displayed after this field. Possible values: **true**, **false**.

decimal_place.description: Number of decimal places configured for numeric fields.

display_label.description: Display label of the lookup related list.

revalidate_filter_during_edit.description: Indicates if the filter should be revalidated during edit.

api_name.description: API name of the lookup related list.
API name of the lookup target module.

id.description: Unique identifier of the lookup target module.

module.description: Module details for the lookup field.

id.description: Unique identifier of the lookup field.

system_query_id.description: System query ID for the lookup field.

query_details.description: Query details for the lookup field.

lookup.description: Lookup configuration for the field. Empty object if the field is not a lookup. Returned when include_inner_details contains fields.lookup.

return_type.description: The return type of the formula (e.g., text, number).

formula.description: Formula configuration for the field. Empty object if the field is not a formula field. Returned when include_inner_details contains fields.formula.

return_type.description: The return type of the rollup summary (e.g., integer, number).

rollup_summary.description: Rollup summary configuration for the field. Empty object if the field is not a rollup summary. Returned when include_inner_details contains fields.rollup_summary.

pick_list_values.description: List of picklist values for picklist-type fields in the related list.

mask_details.description: Masking configuration for the field. Returned when include_inner_details contains fields.mask_details.

refer_from_field.description: Reference field configuration. Returned when include_inner_details contains fields.refer_from_field.

RelatedListField.description: Represents a field configured as a column in a related list view.

api_name.description: API name of the parent related list.

id.description: Unique identifier of the parent related list.

RelatedListParentReference.description: Represents a reference to a parent related list that this related list depends on for contextual display.

display_value.description: Display value shown to the user in the picklist.

sequence_number.description: Display sequence position of this picklist value.

reference_value.description: Internal reference value associated with this picklist option.

colour_code.description: Color code assigned to this picklist value for visual representation.

actual_value.description: Stored value for this picklist option.

id.description: Unique identifier of the picklist value.

type.description: Type classification of the picklist value.

PickListValue.description: Represents a single picklist option, including its display value, stored value, and visual configuration.

edit.description: Indicates whether the edit operation is allowed on records in the related list. Possible values: **true**, **false**.

create.description: Indicates whether the create operation is allowed on records in the related list. Possible values: **true**, **false**.

bulk_edit.description: Indicates whether the bulk edit operation is allowed on records in the related list. Possible values: **true**, **false**.

delete.description: Indicates whether the delete operation is allowed on records in the related list. Possible values: **true**, **false**.

disassociate.description: Indicates whether records can be disassociated from the related list. Possible values: **true**, **false**.

assign.description: Indicates whether the assign operation is allowed on records in the related list. Possible values: **true**, **false**.

RelatedListRecordOperations.description: Represents the set of record operations permitted for a related list.

sequence_number.description: Display sequence position of this related list in the specified layout.

status.description: Visibility status of the related list in the specified layout. Possible values: **visible**, **user_hidden**, **scheduled_for_deletion**.

name.description: Display name of the layout.

id.description: Unique identifier of the layout.

layout.description: Layout information for which this property override applies.

RelatedListLayoutSpecificProperty.description: Represents layout-specific configuration overrides for a related list, including per-layout sequence and visibility.

api_name.description: API name of the lookup field.

field_label.description: Display label of the lookup field.

id.description: Unique identifier of the lookup field.

field.description: Lookup field configuration for the multiselectlookup relationship.

name.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the currently logged-in user.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSER} - Represents the currently logged-in user.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user, in which only the name property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property is included.

id.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the logged-in user's role record ID.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSERROLE} - Represents the role of the currently logged-in user.

name.description: Represents an optional display label for the predefined role, such as Logged in User Role.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user's role, in which the ID property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and the name property is an optional display label.

related_records_SimpleFilterCriterionVal.description: Represents a predefined placeholder object filter criterion value for lookup fields, applicable with equal or not_equal comparators when the field's data_type is ownerlookup or userlookup. Two forms are supported: (1) the currently logged-in user, represented by passing only the name property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property; and (2) the logged-in user's role, represented by passing the ID property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and an optional display label in the name property. For specific real users or roles that are not predefined, use SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, which requires the ID property.
Represents a Boolean filter criterion value. Applicable only when the field has a Boolean data type (checkbox field).

Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable to any field data_type with the equal comparator.
Possible values:
${EMPTY} - Matches records where the field has no value.
${NOTEMPTY} - Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the field has no value (null or empty string).
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

related_records_SimpleFilterCriterionVal.description: Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator.

x-enumDescriptions.${TODAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the current calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROW}: Matches records where the date field falls on the next calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROWPLUS}: Matches records where the date field is on tomorrow or any later date (tomorrow onwards).
