territories_InvalidRequestError.title: Invalid Request Error

code.description: Represents the error code for the request. Possible values: **INVALID_REQUEST**.

details.description: Represents additional contextual information about the error.

enum: unable to process your request. please verify whether you have entered proper method name, parameter and parameter values.
message.description: Represents the error message returned when the request cannot be processed. Possible values: **unable to process your request. please verify whether you have entered proper method name, parameter and parameter values.**

status.description: Represents the status of the operation. Possible values: **error**.

territories_InvalidRequestError.description: Represents the error response when the request is invalid, such as when the ids parameter exceeds the maximum allowed limit.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the field used for filter operations.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field used for filter application. Supports relationship notation, for example, Deals__r.Stage.

territories_FilterFieldBase.description: Represents the base field reference used in filter operations, containing minimal required properties. The field's data_type is not part of this object; resolve it from the corresponding FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

territories_SimpleFilterCriterionValueSt.description: Represents a string filter criterion value applicable to fields with a data_type of text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime, as well as any data_type not explicitly covered by SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber, SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean, SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectResponse, or the multiselect lookup value schemas.

territories_SimpleFilterCriterionValueNu.description: Represents a numeric filter criterion value applicable to fields with a data_type of integer, currency, or double.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the lookup module record.

name.description: Represents the display name of the lookup module record.

territories_SimpleFilterCriterionValueOb.description: Represents the base minified record structure of a lookup module, containing the record's unique identifier and display name.

allOf.description: Represents the constraint that the ID property is required for the lookup object filter criterion value in request bodies.

territories_SimpleFilterCriterionValueOb.description: Represents a lookup object filter criterion value for request bodies, applicable when the field's data_type is lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup. The ID property is required.

name.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the currently logged-in user.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSER} - Represents the currently logged-in user.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user, in which only the name property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property is included.

id.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the logged-in user's role record ID.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSERROLE} - Represents the role of the currently logged-in user.

name.description: Represents an optional display label for the predefined role, such as Logged in User Role.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user's role, in which the ID property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and the name property is an optional display label.

territories_SimpleFilterCriterionValueOb.description: Represents a predefined placeholder object filter criterion value for lookup fields, applicable with equal or not_equal comparators when the field's data_type is ownerlookup or userlookup. Two forms are supported: (1) the currently logged-in user, represented by passing only the name property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property; and (2) the logged-in user's role, represented by passing the ID property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and an optional display label in the name property. For specific real users or roles that are not predefined, use SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, which requires the ID property.

territories_SimpleFilterCriterionValueBo.description: Represents a Boolean filter criterion value. Applicable only when the field has a Boolean data type (checkbox field).

territories_SimpleFilterCriterionValueGe.description:
Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable to any field data_type with the equal comparator.
Possible values:
${EMPTY} - Matches records where the field has no value.
${NOTEMPTY} - Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the field has no value (null or empty string).
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

territories_SimpleFilterCriterionValueDa.description: Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator.

x-enumDescriptions.${TODAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the current calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROW}: Matches records where the date field falls on the next calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROWPLUS}: Matches records where the date field is on tomorrow or any later date (tomorrow onwards).
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the previous calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAYMINUS}: Matches records where the date field is on yesterday or any earlier date (up to and including yesterday).
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the entire previous calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar week (Monday–Sunday).
x-enumDescriptions.${THISWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has no value set.
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has a value set.

territories_SimpleFilterCriterionValueND.description: Represents a predefined N-period range placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator. Follows the pattern ${NEXT_N_<PERIOD>:<n>} or ${LAST_N_<PERIOD>:<n>}, where PERIOD is DAYS, WEEKS, MONTHS, or YEARS and n is a positive integer. The current period is always excluded from the range.

territories_SimpleFilterCriterionValueAg.description: Represents a predefined age or due-in-days placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime. Follows the pattern ${AGEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field was exactly n days in the past, or ${DUEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field is exactly n days in the future. Supported comparators are equal, not_equal, less_than, greater_than, less_equal, and greater_equal.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
equal - Matches records where the field value equals the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

territories_EqualFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders. Accepts scalar or array values. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the not-equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the not-equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the not-equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
not_equal - Matches records where the field value does not equal the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the not_equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the not_equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

territories_NotEqualFilterCriterionReque.description: Represents a filter criterion for the not_equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

territories_EqualityFilterCriterionReque.description: Represents an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionRequest or NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest schema based on the comparator value.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the text filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the text filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the text comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
like - Matches records where the field value contains the specified pattern.
not_like - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified pattern.
starts_with - Matches records where the field value begins with the specified string.
ends_with - Matches records where the field value ends with the specified string.
contains - Matches records where the field value contains the specified string.
not_contains - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified string.

oneOf.description: Contains an array of primitive string values for the text filter comparator.

value.description: Represents the string filter value used in the text comparator. Accepts a scalar string or an array of string values.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

territories_TextFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value must be a string scalar or array; use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based field types. Object and Boolean values are not supported. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the ordering filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the ordering filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the ordering comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
less_than - Matches records where the field value is less than the specified filter value.
less_equal - Matches records where the field value is less than or equal to the specified filter value.
greater_than - Matches records where the field value is greater than the specified filter value.
greater_equal - Matches records where the field value is greater than or equal to the specified filter value.

value.description: Represents the scalar filter value used in the ordering comparator. Arrays and objects are not supported for ordering comparators.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

territories_OrderingFilterCriterionReque.description: Represents a filter criterion for the less_than, less_equal, greater_than, and greater_equal comparators. The value must be a scalar; arrays and objects are not supported. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the range filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the range filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the range comparison operator applied to the criterion, indicating whether the field value falls within or outside the specified bounds.
Possible values:
between - Matches records where the field value falls within the specified range.
not_between - Matches records where the field value falls outside the specified range.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field is evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

territories_BetweenFilterCriterionReques.description: Represents a filter criterion for the between and not_between comparators. The value must be an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the set filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the set filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the set membership comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
in - Matches records where the field value is in the specified set of values.
not_in - Matches records where the field value is not in the specified set of values.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values used in the set comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

territories_SetFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the in and not_in comparators. The value must be an array of primitive values. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based types, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the multi-select lookup filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the multi-select lookup filter criterion is applied. The field must have a data_type of multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

comparator.description:
Represents the multi-select lookup comparison operator applied to the criterion. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.
Possible values:
include_all - Matches records that include all specified lookup values.
include_any - Matches records that include at least one of the specified lookup values.
exclude_all - Matches records that exclude all specified lookup values.
exclude_any - Matches records that exclude at least one of the specified lookup values.

value.description: Contains an array of lookup object references used in the multi-select comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

territories_MultiSelectLookupFilterCrite.description: Represents a filter criterion for the include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup. The value must be an array of SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest lookup objects.

territories_SimpleFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a simple field-based filter criterion that dispatches to the appropriate comparator-specific schema. The equal and not_equal comparators support scalar or array values; text comparators support scalar or array strings; ordering comparators require a scalar; between and not_between comparators require a two-element array; in and not_in comparators require an array of primitives; and include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators require an array of lookup objects and apply only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

group_operator.description:
Represents the logical operator applied between the filter conditions in the group.
Possible values:
AND - All conditions in the group must be satisfied.
OR - At least one condition in the group must be satisfied.
and - Equivalent to AND; all conditions in the group must be satisfied.
or - Equivalent to OR; at least one condition in the group must be satisfied.

territories_GroupedFilterCriterionReques.description: Represents a grouped filter criterion containing multiple filter conditions evaluated with a logical operator. Supports recursive nesting for complex filtering logic.

territories_FilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents the top-level filter criterion for data selection, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators.

allOf.description: Represents the constraint that both the ID and name properties are required for the lookup object filter criterion value in response bodies.

territories_SimpleFilterCriterionValueOb.description: Represents a lookup object filter criterion value for response bodies, applicable when the field's data_type is lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup. Both the ID and name properties are included.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the equal filter criterion response.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the equal filter criterion was applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the equal comparison operator returned for the criterion.
Possible values:
equal - Matches records where the field value equals the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values returned for the equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value returned for the equal comparator. Contains a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the equal filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

territories_EqualFilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectResponse for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the not-equal filter criterion response.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the not-equal filter criterion was applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the not-equal comparison operator returned for the criterion.
Possible values:
not_equal - Matches records where the field value does not equal the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values returned for the not_equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value returned for the not_equal comparator. Contains a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the not-equal filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

territories_NotEqualFilterCriterionRespo.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the not_equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based types; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for numeric types; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectResponse for lookup types; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role placeholders.

territories_EqualityFilterCriterionRespo.description: Represents the response for an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionResponse or NotEqualFilterCriterionResponse schema based on the comparator value.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the text filter criterion response.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the text filter criterion was applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the text comparison operator returned for the criterion.
Possible values:
like - Matches records where the field value contains the specified pattern.
not_like - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified pattern.
starts_with - Matches records where the field value begins with the specified string.
ends_with - Matches records where the field value ends with the specified string.
contains - Matches records where the field value contains the specified string.
not_contains - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified string.

oneOf.description: Contains an array of primitive string values returned for the text filter comparator.

value.description: Represents the string filter value returned for the text comparator. Contains a scalar string or an array of string values.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the text filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

territories_TextFilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value is a string scalar or array; SimpleFilterCriterionValueString applies to text-based field types.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the ordering filter criterion response.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the ordering filter criterion was applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the ordering comparison operator returned for the criterion.
Possible values:
less_than - Matches records where the field value is less than the specified filter value.
less_equal - Matches records where the field value is less than or equal to the specified filter value.
greater_than - Matches records where the field value is greater than the specified filter value.
greater_equal - Matches records where the field value is greater than or equal to the specified filter value.

value.description: Represents the scalar filter value returned for the ordering comparator.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the ordering filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

territories_OrderingFilterCriterionRespo.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the less_than, less_equal, greater_than, and greater_equal comparators. The value is a scalar; arrays and objects are not valid.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the range filter criterion response.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the range filter criterion was applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the range comparison operator returned for the criterion, indicating whether the field value falls within or outside the specified bounds.
Possible values:
between - Matches records where the field value falls within the specified range.
not_between - Matches records where the field value falls outside the specified range.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field was evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the between filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

territories_BetweenFilterCriterionRespon.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the between and not_between comparators. The value is an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the set filter criterion response.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the set filter criterion was applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the set membership comparison operator returned for the criterion.
Possible values:
in - Matches records where the field value is in the specified set of values.
not_in - Matches records where the field value is not in the specified set of values.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values returned for the set comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the set filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

territories_SetFilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the in and not_in comparators. The value is an array of primitive values.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the multi-select lookup filter criterion response.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the multi-select lookup filter criterion was applied. The field has a data_type of multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

comparator.description:
Represents the multi-select lookup comparison operator returned for the criterion. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.
Possible values:
include_all - Matches records that include all specified lookup values.
include_any - Matches records that include at least one of the specified lookup values.
exclude_all - Matches records that exclude all specified lookup values.
exclude_any - Matches records that exclude at least one of the specified lookup values.

value.description: Contains an array of lookup object references returned for the multi-select comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the multi-select lookup filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

territories_MultiSelectLookupFilterCrite.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

territories_SimpleFilterCriterionRespons.description: Represents the response for a simple field-based filter criterion, dispatching to the appropriate comparator-specific response schema.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

group_operator.description:
Represents the logical operator applied between the filter conditions in the group.
Possible values:
AND - All conditions in the group must be satisfied.
OR - At least one condition in the group must be satisfied.
and - Equivalent to AND; all conditions in the group must be satisfied.
or - Equivalent to OR; at least one condition in the group must be satisfied.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the grouped filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable condition within the group.

territories_GroupedFilterCriterionRespon.description: Represents the grouped filter criterion returned in the response, containing multiple filter conditions evaluated with a logical operator. Supports recursive nesting for complex filtering logic.

code.description:
Indicates the error classification assigned to this response.
Possible values:
**NOT_SUPPORTED** - The referenced field API name is not permitted for use in filter criteria.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field that is not supported for use in filter criteria and triggered this error.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSONPath location of the unsupported field within the filter expression.

param_name.description: Represents the name of the filter request parameter that carried the unsupported field API name.

details.description: Contains the contextual details identifying the unsupported field that caused the error, including its API name, its location within the filter expression, and the name of the filter parameter involved.

message.description: Contains a descriptive message summarizing the nature of the error returned by the API.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome status of the API response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because an unsupported field API name was used in the filter criteria.

territories_FilterNotSupportedApiName.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter criterion references a field API name that is not supported for filtering. The details object identifies the unsupported field and its location within the filter parameter.

code.description:
Indicates the error classification for this failure.
Possible values:
**EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING** - None of the expected filter fields were present in the submitted filter object.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of a field expected to be present in the filter object.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSON path at which the expected field should be present within the filter object.

items.description: Represents a single expected field entry, providing its API name and the JSON path at which it was anticipated within the filter expression.

expected_fields.description: Contains the collection of fields that the filter object was expected to include, of which at least one must be present for the request to be valid. Each entry identifies the field by its API name and JSON path.

param_name.description: Indicates the name of the filter parameter associated with the empty filter object error. This field is a filter-specific extension to the standard error detail structure.

details.description: Contains structured diagnostic detail about the empty filter object, including the parameter name and the list of fields that were expected but entirely absent from the filter expression.

message.description: Contains a descriptive message summarizing the empty filter object error.

status.description:
Represents the outcome status of the API response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because the filter object did not contain any of the expected fields.

territories_FilterEmptyFilterObject.description: Represents the error response returned when a filter object is submitted without any recognized fields — such as group or criteria — where at least one is required for the expression to be valid. The error code is EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING.

code.description:
Indicates the error code identifying the category of failure.
Possible values:
**MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND** - A mandatory field was absent from the filter criteria.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the mandatory field that was not found in the filter criteria.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the mandatory field that is missing from the filter criteria.

param_name.description: Represents the parameter name associated with the missing mandatory field, as a filter-specific extension to the standard error detail.

details.description: Contains detailed information identifying the mandatory field that is absent from the request, including its API name, JSON path location, and, as a filter-specific extension, its parameter name.

message.description: Contains a brief error message describing which mandatory field was not found in the filter criteria.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome status of the response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because a mandatory field was absent from the filter criteria.

territories_FilterMandatoryNotFound.description: Represents an error response returned when a mandatory field required by the filter criteria is absent from the request. Includes a filter-specific param_name field that extends the standard MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND error structure.

code.description:
Indicates the category of error associated with this response.
Possible values:
**INVALID_DATA** - An unsupported comparator operator was provided for the filter field.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the filter field to which an unsupported comparator operator was applied.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the specific filter field within the request payload that carries the unsupported comparator operator.

param_name.description: Indicates the name of the filter parameter whose comparator was rejected, scoped as a filter-specific extension to the standard error detail.

items.description: Represents a single comparator value that is valid and accepted for the associated filter field.

supported_values.description: Contains the list of comparator values that are valid for the offending filter field.

details.description: Contains structured details identifying the filter field that received an unsupported comparator, including its location, parameter name, and the list of valid comparator values accepted for that field.

message.description: Contains a descriptive summary of the invalid-comparator error, identifying the rejected operator and the affected filter parameter.

status.description:
Indicates the overall outcome of the request.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed due to an invalid filter comparator.

territories_FilterInvalidComparator.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter field is provided with a comparator operator that is not supported for that field. The error code is INVALID_DATA.

code.description:
Indicates the error classification assigned to this response.
Possible values:
**DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING** - A filter field's required comparator value is absent because its upstream dependee field was not supplied in the filter criteria.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the upstream dependee field whose value constrains the comparator requirements of the field currently in error.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSONPath location of the upstream dependee field within the filter expression.

dependee.description: Represents the upstream field whose value constrains the comparator requirements of the field currently in error. Contains the API name and JSONPath location of that upstream dependee field within the filter expression.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the filter field whose comparator value is absent, identifying which field in the filter expression triggered the error.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSONPath location of the field in error within the filter expression, pinpointing where the missing comparator value was detected.

param_name.description: Indicates the name of the filter parameter that carries the filter criteria in which the missing comparator value was detected.

details.description: Contains structured details about the missing comparator value error, identifying the field in error, the upstream dependee field that constrains it, and the filter parameter context in which the violation occurred.

message.description: Contains a descriptive message summarizing the missing comparator value error.

status.description:
Represents the outcome status of the response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because a required comparator value was absent from the filter criteria.

territories_FilterFieldComparatorValueMi.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter field that requires a comparator value is submitted without one, typically because a required upstream dependee field is absent from the filter expression.

code.description:
Indicates the error type for this response.
Possible values:
**DEPENDENT_MISMATCH** - The comparator supplied for the field does not match the set of comparators permitted given the current value of the dependee field.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the upstream dependee field whose value constrains the set of comparators permitted for the field currently in error.

json_path.description: Contains the JSONPath expression locating the dependee field within the filter expression submitted in the request.

dependee.description: Represents the upstream field whose current value determines which comparators are valid for the field identified in `api_name`. Contains the upstream field's API name and its location within the filter expression.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the field whose supplied comparator value does not match the comparators permitted given the current value of the dependee field.

json_path.description: Contains the JSONPath expression locating the field in error within the filter expression submitted in the request.

items.description: Represents a single comparator value that is valid for the field in error given the current value of the dependee field.

supported_values.description: Contains the complete set of comparator values that are permitted for the field in error, as determined by the current value of the dependee field.

param_name.description: Indicates the name of the filter query parameter that carries the filter expression containing the comparator mismatch.

details.description: Contains structured details about the comparator mismatch, identifying the field in error, the upstream dependee field whose value constrains valid comparators, and the set of comparator values that are permitted.

message.description: Represents a short, descriptive summary of the comparator-field dependency violation.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome of the request.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed due to a comparator value mismatch in the filter criteria.

territories_FilterFieldComparatorMismatc.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter field's comparator value does not match any of the values permitted by the upstream dependee field's value. Contains the offending field's API name and JSONPath location, the dependee field's identity, the filter parameter context, and the list of supported comparator values.

code.description:
Indicates the category of error associated with this response.
Possible values:
**DEPENDENT_MISMATCH** - A filter field's value has a data type that conflicts with the requirement set by the dependee field.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the dependee field whose value drives the data type requirement for the offending filter field.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSON path locating the dependee field within the request payload.

dependee.description: Represents the field whose current value dictates the required data type for the offending filter field.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the filter field whose supplied value does not match the data type required by the dependee field.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSON path locating the filter field whose value carries the data type mismatch within the request payload.

expected_data_type.description: Indicates the data type expected by the dependee field against which the submitted filter value was validated.

param_name.description: Represents the filter-specific query parameter name associated with the field that failed value validation.

details.description: Contains diagnostic details identifying the offending filter field, its expected data type, the dependee field that governs that expectation, and the filter parameter in which the mismatch was detected.

message.description: Contains a descriptive explanation of the filter field value mismatch error.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome status of the response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because a filter field value did not match the type required by the dependee field.

territories_FilterFieldValueMismatch.description: Represents the error response returned when a filter field's value carries a data type that does not satisfy the requirement imposed by its dependee field's current value.

code.description:
Indicates the classification of the error.
Possible values:
**DEPENDENT_MISMATCH** - The comparator-driven value failed validation due to constraints imposed by the dependee field.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the dependee field whose constraints triggered the comparator value validation failure.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the dependee field within the request structure whose constraints govern the comparator value validation.

dependee.description: Represents the dependee field whose state or constraints govern the validation rules applied to the comparator value of the current filter field.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the filter field whose supplied value does not match the requirements of the comparator operator in use.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the specific filter field whose value is incompatible with the comparator operator applied to it.

param_name.description: Represents the filter-specific parameter name identifying the request parameter associated with the comparator value mismatch.

details.description: Contains structured diagnostic details identifying the filter field whose comparator-driven value failed dependency validation, including the controlling dependee field reference.

message.description: Contains a descriptive error message summarizing the comparator-value mismatch encountered in the filter request.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome status of the response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because the comparator-driven value did not satisfy dependency validation rules.

territories_FilterComparatorValueMismatc.description: Represents an error returned when a value associated with a filter comparator fails validation due to constraints imposed by a dependee field. This error targets the value driven by the comparator rather than the comparator operator selection itself.

code.description:
Represents the error classification code for this response.
Possible values:
**INVALID_DATA** - The filter parameter was supplied with an incorrect data type.

expected_data_type.description: Represents the data type that the filter parameter is required to carry for the request to be valid.

param_name.description: Represents the name of the query or body parameter — such as `filters` — that carries the filter criteria and was supplied with an invalid data type.

details.description: Contains structured details about the data type mismatch, including the name of the offending filter parameter and the data type it is expected to carry.

message.description: Represents a descriptive message explaining the data type error encountered for the filter parameter.

status.description:
Represents the outcome of the request.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed due to an invalid filter parameter data type.

territories_FilterInvalidParamDataType.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter parameter is supplied with an incorrect data type. Contains the error code, a descriptive message, and details identifying the offending parameter along with its expected data type.

code.description:
Indicates the category of error returned.
Possible values:
**INVALID_DATA** - A field in the filter criteria was supplied with an incorrect data type.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the filter field whose supplied value does not match the field's required data type.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSONPath location within the filter criteria expression where the data type mismatch was detected.

expected_data_type.description: Indicates the data type that the identified filter field requires, against which the submitted value was evaluated and found incompatible.

param_name.description: Indicates the name of the query or body parameter that carried the filter criteria containing the invalid field value.

details.description: Contains diagnostic details identifying the specific filter field whose value failed the data type check, including its API name, its location in the filter expression, the expected data type, and the name of the filter parameter that carried the criteria.

message.description: Represents a brief description of the data type error encountered for the filter field.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome of the request.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed due to an invalid data type in the filter criteria.

FilterInvalidFieldDataType.description: Represents the error response returned when a field within the filter criteria contains a value of an incorrect data type. Includes the API name of the offending field, its JSONPath location within the filter expression, and the data type the field expects.

code.description:
Indicates the error code identifying the category of failure.
Possible values:
**INVALID_DATA** - The field referenced in the filter criteria is not supported for filtering.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field that is not supported within the filter criteria expression.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the unsupported field within the filter criteria structure.

param_name.description: Represents the parameter name associated with the unsupported field, as a filter-specific extension to the standard error detail.

details.description: Contains details identifying the specific field that is not supported in filter criteria, including its API name, JSON path, and associated parameter name.

message.description: Contains a brief error message describing why the specified field is not supported in the filter criteria.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome status of the response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because a field type not supported in filter criteria was referenced.

FilterFieldNotSupportedInCriteria.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter criteria field references a field type that is not supported for filtering, such as file upload or image upload fields.

code.description:
Represents the error code that identifies the category of validation failure.
Possible values:
INVALID_DATA - Indicates that the value provided for a criterion field does not match the expected data type.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the criterion field whose value was supplied with an invalid data type.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path that locates the specific field within the request body where the invalid data type was detected.

expected_data_type.description: Represents the data type that the API expected for the criterion field identified by the API name, against which the supplied value was validated.

details.description: Contains the details of the invalid data type error, including the API name of the offending criterion field, its JSON path within the request body, and the data type that was expected.

message.description: Represents the error message describing the invalid data type failure in a form suitable for display or logging.

status.description:
Represents the response status for this error response.
Possible values:
error - Indicates that the request failed due to an invalid data type on a criterion field.

territories_InvalidDataType.description: Represents the error response returned when a criterion field value is provided with an incorrect data type. Contains the error code, a descriptive message, the response status, and details identifying the offending field and its expected data type.

code.description:
Represents the error code that identifies the category of failure for this error response.
Possible values:
DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING - Indicates that the comparator value required from the dependee criterion field is absent, preventing the comparator from being evaluated.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the dependee criterion field whose comparator value is absent and caused the evaluation failure.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path that locates the dependee criterion field within the request body, identifying where the missing comparator value was expected.

dependee.description: Represents the dependee criterion field — that is, the field whose value determines what the current comparator accepts — and whose missing comparator value triggered this error. Contains the API name and JSON path of that dependee field.

api_name.description: API name of the criterion field that triggered the DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the criterion field in error within the request body.

details.description: Contains detailed information about the criterion field that caused the error and the dependee field whose comparator value is missing, including the API name and JSON path for each.

message.description: Error message describing the DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING condition returned in the response envelope.

status.description: Status of the response. Possible values: error.

territories_FieldComparatorValueMissing.description: Represents the error response returned when a criterion comparator cannot be applied because the comparator value supplied by the dependee field is absent. Carries error code DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING along with details identifying both the field in error and the dependee field whose value is missing.

code.description: Error code identifying the type of field comparator mismatch condition. Possible values: DEPENDENT_MISMATCH.

api_name.description: API name of the dependee field that determines the valid comparator values for the criterion field in error.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the dependee field within the request body.

dependee.description: The dependee field whose value determines which comparator values are valid for the criterion field that raised the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error. Contains the API name and JSON path of the dependee field.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the criterion field whose comparator value does not match any of the supported values determined by the dependee field.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the criterion field whose comparator value does not match any of the supported values determined by the dependee field.

items.description: Represents one supported comparator value valid for the criterion field, as determined by the dependee field.

supported_values.description: Contains the comparator values that are valid for the criterion field, as determined by the dependee field.

details.description: Detailed information about the field comparator mismatch, including the API name and JSON path of the criterion field in error, the dependee field that governs valid comparator values, and the array of supported comparator values.

message.description: Represents the error message describing the comparator mismatch condition for the criterion field.

status.description: Represents the status of the error response. Possible values: error.

territories_FieldComparatorMismatch.description: Error schema returned when the comparator value supplied for a criterion field does not match the valid comparator values determined by its dependee field. Contains the error code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH and a details object identifying the criterion field, its dependee field, and the list of supported comparator values.

code.description: Represents the error code identifying the type of error condition encountered. Possible values: DEPENDENT_MISMATCH.

api_name.description: API name of the dependee field that determines the expected data type for the criterion field in error.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the dependee field within the request body.

dependee.description: Represents the dependee field whose value determines the expected data type for the criterion field that raised the mismatch error. Contains the API name and JSON path of the dependee field.

api_name.description: API name of the criterion field whose value does not match the expected data type.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the criterion field whose value contains the data type mismatch.

expected_data_type.description: Data type expected for the criterion field value, as determined by the dependee field.

details.description: Contains detailed information about the data type mismatch, including the criterion field that raised the error, the dependee field whose value determines the expected data type, and the expected data type itself.

message.description: Descriptive message providing details about the field value mismatch error.

status.description: Status of the response. Possible values: error.

territories_FieldValueMismatch.description: Represents the error response returned when the data type of the value supplied for a criterion field does not match the expected data type determined by the dependee field. Returned with error code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Contains details identifying the mismatched criterion field, its dependee field, and the expected data type.

code.description: Error code identifying the comparator dependency mismatch condition. Possible values: DEPENDENT_MISMATCH.

api_name.description: API name of the dependee field whose value imposed the violated validation rule on the criterion field comparator.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the dependee field within the request body.

dependee.description: Identifies the dependee field whose value determines the validation rules applied to the comparator of the criterion field in error. Contains the API name and JSON path of the dependee field.

api_name.description: API name of the criterion field whose comparator value does not satisfy the dependency rule imposed by the dependee field.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the criterion field with the invalid comparator value within the request body.

details.description: Object containing diagnostic detail about the dependency mismatch, including the criterion field with the invalid comparator value (api_name, json_path) and the dependee field that imposed the violated validation rule (dependee.api_name, dependee.json_path).

message.description: Descriptive message providing details about the comparator value mismatch error.

status.description: Status of the response indicating the outcome of the request. Possible values: error.

territories_ComparatorValueMismatch.description: Error schema returned when the comparator value itself does not satisfy the dependency validation rules imposed by the dependee field. Carries error code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH and includes details identifying the criterion field with the invalid comparator value, its dependee field (api_name, json_path), and the criterion field own api_name and json_path.

code.description: Error code identifying the category of error. Possible values: INVALID_DATA.

api_name.description: API name of the criterion field for which an invalid comparator was specified.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the criterion field with the invalid comparator within the request body.

items.description: Represents one valid comparator value accepted for the criterion field type.

supported_values.description: Contains the comparator values that are valid for the criterion field type.

details.description: Contains structured information about the invalid comparator error. Identifies the offending criterion field by API name and JSON path, and provides the list of supported comparator values valid for the given field type.

message.description: Descriptive error message conveying the nature of the invalid comparator condition to the caller.

status.description: Status of the response indicating the outcome of the request. Possible values: error.

territories_InvalidComparator.description: Error schema returned when the comparator specified in a criterion field is not one of the allowed comparator values for the given field type. Returned with error code INVALID_DATA. The details object identifies the offending field by API name and JSON path, and enumerates the supported comparator values.

code.description: Identifies the error code that signals the lookup field limit has been exceeded. Possible values: LOOKUP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

name.description: Identifies the location — such as criteria or cross_filters — where the lookup field count exceeded the allowed limit.

api_name.description: Specifies the API name of a lookup field that was counted against the lookup field limit for the specified location.

items.description: Represents one lookup field used in the specified criterion location that was counted against the lookup field limit. Each entry exposes the API name of the offending field.

lookup_fields.description: Lists the lookup fields present in the specified location that contributed to exceeding the allowed lookup field limit. Contains between 1 and 100 entries, each identifying a single lookup field by its API name.

lookup_limit.description: Specifies the maximum number of lookup fields permitted in the associated location, such as criteria or cross_filters.

items.description: Represents one location — such as criteria or cross_filters — where lookup field usage has exceeded the allowed limit. Each entry identifies the location by name, lists the offending lookup fields, and specifies the maximum number of lookup fields permitted in that location.

used_in.description: Lists the locations (for example, "criteria" or "cross_filters") where lookup field usage exceeded the allowed limit. Each entry in the array contains a location name, the lookup fields involved, and the applicable lookup limit. The array contains between 1 and 10 items.

details.description: Provides structured information about the locations where the lookup field count exceeded the allowed limit. The required used_in array contains objects that each specify a location name (such as "criteria" or "cross_filters"), the lookup fields in use, and the applicable lookup limit.

message.description: Contains a descriptive error message explaining why the lookup field limit was exceeded.

status.description: Indicates the outcome of the request. Possible values: error.

territories_LookupLimitExceeded.description: Represents the error response returned when the count of lookup fields used in criterion expressions exceeds the allowed limit. The error code is LOOKUP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED. The details object contains a used_in array (minItems: 1, maxItems: 10) in which each entry identifies an affected location by name and provides the relevant lookup fields and the applicable lookup limit.

code.description:
Represents the error code that identifies the category of validation failure.

WebhookRequestBody.description:
Represents the request body configuration for the outgoing webhook request. For type **form_data**, provide form_data_content with module_parameters and custom_parameters; format may be null. 

For type **raw**, supply raw_data_content and a format value of JSON, XML, Text, or HTML. For type **none**, the body carries no content and format may be null.
WebhookRequestBody.x-zs-llm-description: Configures the webhook request body; type and format are required for all variants. For type=form_data: supply form_data_content with module_parameters and custom_parameters sub-arrays; format may be null. For type=raw: supply raw_data_content (a string) and a format value of JSON, XML, Text, or HTML note the field is raw_data_content, not data, and format, not content_type. For type=none: the body carries no content and format may be null, but the field must still be present. Example form_data: {"type":"form_data","format":null,"form_data_content":{"module_parameters":[{"name":"Lead_Source","value":"${!Leads.Lead_Source}"}],"custom_parameters":[{"name":"key","value":"val"}]}}. Example (raw): {"type":"raw","format":"JSON","raw_data_content":"{\"lead\":\"${!Leads.Full_Name}\"}"}.

WebhookUpdateInput.description:
Represents the writable fields for updating an existing webhook. Full-replacement semantics apply all required fields must be present, as omitted fields reset to defaults or null. 

The module field is immutable; providing a different module returns NOT_ALLOWED. System-managed read-only fields must be omitted.

All required fields (name, module, url, http_method, authentication, feature_type) must be included partial updates are not supported. Module is immutable and returns NOT_ALLOWED if changed. System-managed read-only fields must be omitted.

AutomationUsageResource.title: Automation Usage Resource

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the automation action, such as an email notification ID or a webhook ID.

name.description: Represents the display name of the automation action. Falls back to the name recorded in the automation audit log when the action has been deleted.

layout_id.description: Represents the identifier of the wizard layout associated with the automation action. Present only when the include_inner_details query parameter is set to resource.layout_id and the action is linked to a wizard layout.

AutomationUsageResource.description: Represents a reference to the specific automation action that generated usage. The identifier and name are resolved from the action's configuration record; for deleted actions, the name falls back to the corresponding automation audit log entry. When the include_inner_details parameter includes resource.layout_id and the action is associated with a wizard layout, a layout_id field is included in the representation.

AutomationUsageDataEntry.title: Automation Usage Data Entry

date.description: Represents the date of this usage data point in YYYY-MM-DD format. All dates are evaluated in the organization's time zone.

count.description: Represents the number of times the automation action was executed on this date. When the group_by parameter is set to 'date' only, this value reflects the total across all actions.

type.description: Represents the automation feature type associated with the reported executions. Values correspond to the filter types supported by the type query parameter, such as workflow_rules, approval_process, Blueprint, email_notifications, webhooks, and kiosks.

AutomationUsageDataEntry.description: Represents a single daily usage data point capturing the execution count for an automation action. When the group_by parameter includes resource, the embedded resource object identifies the individual email notification or webhook. When group_by is date only, the resource object is omitted and the count reflects total executions across all actions for that day. The type field indicates the automation feature responsible for the executions, such as workflow_rules, approval_process, or Blueprint.

AutomationUsagePaginationInfo.title: Automation Usage Pagination Info

per_page.description: Represents the number of records returned in each page of the result set.

count.description: Represents the number of records included in the current page of results.

page.description: Represents the one-based index of the current page within the paginated result set.

more_records.description:
Indicates whether additional pages of results are available beyond the current page.
Possible values:
true - More records exist beyond the current page.
false - The current page contains the last records.

max_limit.description: Represents the edition-specific daily execution cap for the automation action type. For email notifications, this reflects the WORKFLOWALERT day limit; for webhooks, it reflects the WFWEBHOOK day limit. Lower-tier editions carry smaller caps.

AutomationUsagePaginationInfo.description: Represents pagination metadata returned with automation usage report responses. Includes a max_limit value that reflects the edition-specific daily execution cap for the relevant action type, derived from the organization's feature limits.

AutomationUsageReportResponse.title: Automation Usage Report Response

data_usage.description: Contains the collection of usage data points for the queried period. Each entry represents the execution count for a specific automation action on a given date. Returns an empty array when no usage exists for the queried period.

AutomationUsageReportResponse.description: Represents a successful response from an automation usage report endpoint. Contains an array of daily usage data points alongside pagination metadata that includes the edition-specific daily execution cap. When no usage exists for the queried period, the endpoint returns an empty data array rather than null, and the response resolves with HTTP 200.
