_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

SocialActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that publishes a post to a social network such as Facebook or Twitter when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
SocialActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline social action for Facebook (comment_to_post, reply_to_comment, like_to_comment, reply_to_message) or Twitter (retweet, reply_to_tweet). Available only with matching social triggers (fb_* or tw_*). Limit 1 per type per rule. details.content required for comment/reply types, not needed for like/retweet.

name.description: Represents the display name of the EmailCreateRecord action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this as a EmailCreateRecord action within the workflow rule. The value is fixed for this action type and must be supported by the target module and trigger event.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the EmailCreateRecord action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

EmailCreateRecordActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that creates a record via an email-based trigger, applicable to modules such as Leads or Contacts.
EmailCreateRecordActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='create_record_email'. Creates a Leads or Contacts record via email. Limit 1/rule. Requires details.module (api_name: 'Leads' or 'Contacts') and details.field_mappings (exactly 1 entry specifying owner assignment: field with value.type user|role|group|country and value.resource.id).

allOf.description: Represents additional field reference constraints for the filter criterion, requiring the `api_name` property to identify the target field.

field.description: Represents the field to which the filter criterion is applied.

comparator.description: Represents the comparison operator applied to the filter criterion. **${ANYVALUE}** is a special value supported only in field update triggers; it matches any change to the monitored field value.

type.description: Indicates whether the criterion value is a direct value or a system variable placeholder.

WorkflowSimpleFilterCriterion.description: Represents a simple filter criterion for workflow rule queries, specifying the field API name, comparator, and value to match.
WorkflowSimpleFilterCriterion.x-zs-llm-description: Single filter criterion in a workflow criteria array. Required: field ({api_name, id}), comparator (equal, not_equal, like, starts_with, etc.), value. Special: '${ANYVALUE}' comparator supported only in field_update triggers to match any value change. Type field distinguishes value source: 'value' (literal), 'merge_field' (runtime token), 'pre_defined' (system), 'field' (other field comparison).

group.description: Represents the array of filter conditions to be evaluated together using the specified logical operator.

group_operator.description: Represents the logical operator applied between the filter conditions in the group.

WorkflowGroupedFilterCriterion.description: Represents a grouped filter criterion containing multiple simple filter conditions evaluated together using a logical operator such as AND or OR.
WorkflowGroupedFilterCriterion.x-zs-llm-description: Grouped filter criterion containing multiple WorkflowSimpleFilterCriterion items joined by group_operator (AND/OR). Use for complex multi-field conditions. The group array holds the individual criteria and group_operator defines their logical relationship.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the field used for filter operations.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field used for filter application. Supports relationship notation, for example, Deals__r.Stage.

workflow_rules_FilterFieldBase.description: Represents the base field reference used in filter operations, containing minimal required properties. The field's data_type is not part of this object; resolve it from the corresponding FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

workflow_rules_SimpleFilterCriterionValu.description: Represents a string filter criterion value applicable to fields with a data_type of text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime, as well as any data_type not explicitly covered by SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber, SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean, SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectResponse, or the multiselect lookup value schemas.
Represents a numeric filter criterion value applicable to fields with a data_type of integer, currency, or double.
Represents a Boolean filter criterion value. Applicable only when the field has a Boolean data type (checkbox field).

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the lookup module record.

name.description: Represents the display name of the lookup module record.

workflow_rules_SimpleFilterCriterionValu.description: Represents the base minified record structure of a lookup module, containing the record's unique identifier and display name.

allOf.description: Represents the constraint that the ID property is required for the lookup object filter criterion value in request bodies.

workflow_rules_SimpleFilterCriterionValu.description: Represents a lookup object filter criterion value for request bodies, applicable when the field's data_type is lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup. The ID property is required.

workflow_rules_AutomationModuleRef.title: Automation Module Reference

api_name.description: API name of the module (e.g., Leads, Contacts, Deals, Vendors).

id.description: Unique module ID (19-digit format). Always use the full ID as returned by GET /settings/modules - truncated or shortened IDs return INVALID_DATA ('the tabId given seems to be invalid'). Optional in requests if api_name is provided; always present in responses.

workflow_rules_AutomationModuleRef.description: PURPOSE: Module reference used across non-associate actions. At least one of api_name or id required (EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING if neither). If both given, must match (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING). GET /settings/modules to discover. Always use full 19-digit module ID.
workflow_rules_AutomationModuleRef.x-zs-llm-description: Module reference for action targeting. At least one of api_name or id required  EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING if neither is present. If both provided and they refer to different modules  AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING. Obtain from getModules. Used in most non-associate action details to specify where the action operates.

AutomationAssignOwnerResource.title: Assign Owner Resource

id.description: Unique identifier of the target entity. Obtain from the corresponding API: GET /settings/users (for user), GET /settings/roles (for role), GET /settings/user_groups (for group), GET /settings/automation/assignment_rules (for assignment_rule), or GET /settings/profiles (for profile).

name.description: Display name of the target entity. Optional in POST/PUT requests (server resolves from id); always present in GET responses.

type.description: Type of the target entity. Present in GET responses; not required in POST/PUT requests.

AutomationAssignOwnerResource.description: PURPOSE: Resource reference for assign_to entry. MANDATORY: id (string). OPTIONAL: name, type. Obtain from GET /settings/users (user), /settings/roles (role), /settings/user_groups (group), /settings/automation/assignment_rules (assignment_rule), /settings/profiles (profile). If both id and name given, must match (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING).
AutomationAssignOwnerResource.x-zs-llm-description: Resource reference within an assign_to entry. id is mandatory (DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING if absent). name is optional (server resolves from id). type indicates resource kind when present. Obtain IDs from: getUsers (user), getRoles (role), getUserGroups (group), getAssignmentRules (assignment_rule), getProfiles (profile).

AutomationAssignToResourceEntry.title: Assign To Resource Entry

type.description: Assignment method. Determines what kind of entity receives ownership. Values: "user" - assign to a specific CRM user (GET /settings/users), for round-robin include multiple assign_to entries of type=user; "role" - assign to a user holding the specified role (GET /settings/roles), system picks an eligible user at execution time; "group" - assign to a member of the specified user group (GET /settings/user_groups); "assignment_rule" - assign using a pre-configured assignment rule (GET /settings/automation/assignment_rules), the rule's criteria and round-robin logic determine the final owner; "profile" - assign to a user matching the specified profile (GET /settings/profiles), must include associated_to=team_profile.

allow_agent_user.description: Whether to allow assignment to an agent user or not. When true, the record can be assigned to an agent user also. When false, agent users are excluded from assignment. Applicable only for types: role, group, profile, merge_field, criteria. Not supported for types user and assignment_rule.

associated_to.description: Association context for profile-based assignment. Must be "team_profile" when type=profile. Not applicable for other assignment types; if provided for a non-profile type, the API returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH.

details.description: Always null for resource-based assignments. Present in GET responses for schema consistency with other assign_to types.

AutomationAssignToResourceEntry.description: PURPOSE: assign_to entry for resource-based ownership. MANDATORY: type (user|role|group|assignment_rule|profile), resource ({id, name}). For type=profile: associated_to must be 'team_profile'. For round-robin: use multiple entries of type=user.
AutomationAssignToResourceEntry.x-zs-llm-description: assign_to entry where ownership is assigned to a specific resource. type selects the resource kind: user, role, group, assignment_rule, or profile. resource object provides the target's id and optionally name. For profile type: associated_to must be 'team_profile'. Returns DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING if resource is omitted.

AutomationAssignToMergeFieldEntry.title: Assign To Merge Field Entry

type.description: Assignment method indicating merge field resolution.

api_name.description: Merge field token referencing a user-type field. Must use the format ${!Module.User_Field} ,${!Module.Lookup_Field_API_Name.User_Field} where Field is a user-type field (data_type=ownerlookup or userlookup) from the trigger module. Fetch valid fields from GET /settings/fields?module={module_api_name}. Common user-type fields: Owner, Created_By, Modified_By. Examples: ${!Leads.Created_By}, ${!Deals.Owner}, ${!Contacts.Account_Manager}.

details.description: Contains the merge field reference that resolves to a user at execution time.

resource.description: Always null for merge field assignments. The owner is resolved dynamically from the merge field at execution time.

allow_agent_user.description: Whether to allow assignment to an agent user or not. When true, the record can be assigned to an agent user also. When false, agent users are excluded from assignment. Applicable only for types: role, group, profile, merge_field, criteria. Not supported for types user and assignment_rule.

AutomationAssignToMergeFieldEntry.description: PURPOSE: assign_to entry for merge-field-based ownership. Resolves to a user at execution time from a user-type field. MANDATORY: type (const 'merge_field'), details.api_name (merge field token e.g., '${!Leads.Created_By}'). Field must be data_type=ownerlookup or userlookup. GET /settings/fields?module={api_name} to discover.
AutomationAssignToMergeFieldEntry.x-zs-llm-description: assign_to entry where ownership resolves at runtime from a user-type lookup field on the trigger record. type must be 'merge_field'. details.api_name specifies the field (e.g., a custom user lookup). The field must be a user-type field  non-user fields return INVALID_DATA.

name.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the currently logged-in user.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSER} - Represents the currently logged-in user.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user, in which only the name property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property is included.

id.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the logged-in user's role record ID.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSERROLE} - Represents the role of the currently logged-in user.

name.description: Represents an optional display label for the predefined role, such as Logged in User Role.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user's role, in which the ID property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and the name property is an optional display label.

workflow_rules_SimpleFilterCriterionValu.description: Represents a predefined placeholder object filter criterion value for lookup fields, applicable with equal or not_equal comparators when the field's data_type is ownerlookup or userlookup. Two forms are supported: (1) the currently logged-in user, represented by passing only the name property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property; and (2) the logged-in user's role, represented by passing the ID property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and an optional display label in the name property. For specific real users or roles that are not predefined, use SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, which requires the ID property.

Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable to any field data_type with the equal comparator.
Possible values:
${EMPTY} - Matches records where the field has no value.
${NOTEMPTY} - Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the field has no value (null or empty string).
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

workflow_rules_SimpleFilterCriterionValu.description: Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator.

x-enumDescriptions.${TODAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the current calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROW}: Matches records where the date field falls on the next calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROWPLUS}: Matches records where the date field is on tomorrow or any later date (tomorrow onwards).
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the previous calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAYMINUS}: Matches records where the date field is on yesterday or any earlier date (up to and including yesterday).
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the entire previous calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar week (Monday–Sunday).
x-enumDescriptions.${THISWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has no value set.
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has a value set.

workflow_rules_SimpleFilterCriterionValu.description: Represents a predefined N-period range placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator. Follows the pattern ${NEXT_N_<PERIOD>:<n>} or ${LAST_N_<PERIOD>:<n>}, where PERIOD is DAYS, WEEKS, MONTHS, or YEARS and n is a positive integer. The current period is always excluded from the range.

Represents a predefined age or due-in-days placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime. Follows the pattern ${AGEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field was exactly n days in the past, or ${DUEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field is exactly n days in the future. Supported comparators are equal, not_equal, less_than, greater_than, less_equal, and greater_equal.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
equal - Matches records where the field value equals the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

workflow_rules_EqualFilterCriterionReque.description: Represents a filter criterion for the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders. Accepts scalar or array values. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the not-equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the not-equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the not-equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
not_equal - Matches records where the field value does not equal the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the not_equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the not_equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

workflow_rules_NotEqualFilterCriterionRe.description: Represents a filter criterion for the not_equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

workflow_rules_EqualityFilterCriterionRe.description: Represents an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionRequest or NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest schema based on the comparator value.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the text filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the text filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the text comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
like - Matches records where the field value contains the specified pattern.
not_like - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified pattern.
starts_with - Matches records where the field value begins with the specified string.
ends_with - Matches records where the field value ends with the specified string.
contains - Matches records where the field value contains the specified string.
not_contains - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified string.

oneOf.description: Contains an array of primitive string values for the text filter comparator.

value.description: Represents the string filter value used in the text comparator. Accepts a scalar string or an array of string values.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

workflow_rules_TextFilterCriterionReques.description: Represents a filter criterion for the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value must be a string scalar or array; use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based field types. Object and Boolean values are not supported. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the ordering filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the ordering filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the ordering comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
less_than - Matches records where the field value is less than the specified filter value.
less_equal - Matches records where the field value is less than or equal to the specified filter value.
greater_than - Matches records where the field value is greater than the specified filter value.
greater_equal - Matches records where the field value is greater than or equal to the specified filter value.

value.description: Represents the scalar filter value used in the ordering comparator. Arrays and objects are not supported for ordering comparators.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

workflow_rules_OrderingFilterCriterionRe.description: Represents a filter criterion for the less_than, less_equal, greater_than, and greater_equal comparators. The value must be a scalar; arrays and objects are not supported. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the range filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the range filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the range comparison operator applied to the criterion, indicating whether the field value falls within or outside the specified bounds.
Possible values:
between - Matches records where the field value falls within the specified range.
not_between - Matches records where the field value falls outside the specified range.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field is evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

workflow_rules_BetweenFilterCriterionReq.description: Represents a filter criterion for the between and not_between comparators. The value must be an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the set filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the set filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the set membership comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
in - Matches records where the field value is in the specified set of values.
not_in - Matches records where the field value is not in the specified set of values.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values used in the set comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

workflow_rules_SetFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the in and not_in comparators. The value must be an array of primitive values. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based types, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the multi-select lookup filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the multi-select lookup filter criterion is applied. The field must have a data_type of multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

comparator.description:
Represents the multi-select lookup comparison operator applied to the criterion. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.
Possible values:
include_all - Matches records that include all specified lookup values.
include_any - Matches records that include at least one of the specified lookup values.
exclude_all - Matches records that exclude all specified lookup values.
exclude_any - Matches records that exclude at least one of the specified lookup values.

value.description: Contains an array of lookup object references used in the multi-select comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

workflow_rules_MultiSelectLookupFilterCr.description: Represents a filter criterion for the include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup. The value must be an array of SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest lookup objects.

workflow_rules_SimpleFilterCriterionRequ.description: Represents a simple field-based filter criterion that dispatches to the appropriate comparator-specific schema. The equal and not_equal comparators support scalar or array values; text comparators support scalar or array strings; ordering comparators require a scalar; between and not_between comparators require a two-element array; in and not_in comparators require an array of primitives; and include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators require an array of lookup objects and apply only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

group_operator.description:
Represents the logical operator applied between the filter conditions in the group.
Possible values:
AND - All conditions in the group must be satisfied.
OR - At least one condition in the group must be satisfied.
and - Equivalent to AND; all conditions in the group must be satisfied.
or - Equivalent to OR; at least one condition in the group must be satisfied.

workflow_rules_GroupedFilterCriterionReq.description: Represents a grouped filter criterion containing multiple filter conditions evaluated with a logical operator. Supports recursive nesting for complex filtering logic.

workflow_rules_FilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents the top-level filter criterion for data selection, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators.

AutomationAssignToCriteriaEntry.title: Assign To Criteria Entry

type.description: Assignment method indicating criteria-based evaluation.

details.description: Contains the filter criteria to evaluate against the triggering record.

resource.description: Always null for criteria-based assignments. The owner is determined by the criteria evaluation logic.

allow_agent_user.description: Whether to allow assignment to an agent user or not. When true, the record can be assigned to an agent user also. When false, agent users are excluded from assignment. Applicable only for types: role, group, profile, merge_field, criteria. Not supported for types user and assignment_rule.

AutomationAssignToCriteriaEntry.description: PURPOSE: assign_to entry for criteria-based ownership. Evaluates filter criteria against the triggering record at execution time. MANDATORY: type (const 'criteria'), details.criteria (filter condition - simple or grouped with AND/OR). Criteria fields must reference valid trigger module fields - GET /settings/fields?module={api_name}.
AutomationAssignToCriteriaEntry.x-zs-llm-description: assign_to entry where ownership is determined by evaluating filter criteria at runtime. type must be 'criteria'. criteria array defines the conditions  the first user matching all criteria becomes the owner. If no user matches, the action silently skips assignment.

AutomationRelatedRecord.title: Automation Related Record

api_name.description: API name of the related module. Events, Calls, Tasks - open activity records, available for all modules and actions (assign_owner, convert). Contacts - available for assign_owner when parent is Accounts, and for convert when converting Leads. Deals - available for assign_owner when parent is Accounts or Contacts, and for convert when converting Leads (requires create_deal=true).

id.description: Unique identifier of the related module. This is the module ID corresponding to the api_name.

AutomationRelatedRecord.description: Identifies a related module whose open records' ownership should be transferred alongside the parent record. Used by assign_owner actions, field_updates (Owner field), and convert actions (change_owner.related_modules). Common activity modules (Tasks, Calls, Events) are available for all modules and actions. Contacts is available for assign_owner when parent is Accounts, and for convert when converting Leads. Deals is available for assign_owner when parent is Accounts or Contacts, and for convert when converting Leads (requires create_deal=true).
AutomationRelatedRecord.x-zs-llm-description: Identifies a related module whose open records should also change ownership when the parent record's owner changes. Used by assign_owner (related_records array) and convert (change_owner.related_modules). Requires api_name and/or id to identify the child module. Valid modules depend on parent: for Leads  Events, Calls, Tasks, Contacts, Deals.

AutomationLookupFieldRef.title: Automation Lookup Field Reference

api_name.description: API name of the lookup field (e.g., Lookup_1_same, Lookup_2_cont).

id.description: Unique field ID of the lookup field.

AutomationLookupFieldRef.description: Identifies a lookup field that links the workflow rule's trigger module to the target module of a cross-module action. For example, if the trigger module is Leads and the assign owner action targets Contacts, the lookup_field identifies which lookup field on Leads points to Contacts (e.g., Lookup_2_cont).
AutomationLookupFieldRef.x-zs-llm-description: Identifies a lookup field linking the rule's trigger module to an action's target module. Required for cross-module field_updates (via related_details.lookup_field) and cross-module assign_owner (when targeting a different module). Both api_name and id should refer to the same lookup field  mismatch returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING. Obtain from getFields filtered by field_type=lookup.

AutomationAssignOwnerDetails.title: Automation Assign Owner Details

items.description: Represents a single owner-assignment entry that determines how the new record owner is resolved. Each entry is one of three variants: AutomationAssignToResourceEntry (assigns ownership to a specific user, role, group, assignment rule, or profile), AutomationAssignToMergeFieldEntry (resolves the owner at runtime from a user-type lookup field on the trigger record), or AutomationAssignToCriteriaEntry (determines the owner by evaluating filter criteria at runtime).

assign_to.description: Specifies how the new owner is determined. Each entry defines an assignment method  - a specific user, role, group, assignment rule, profile, merge field, or criteria-based filter. For round-robin assignment across multiple users, provide multiple entries of type=user. For criteria-based assignment, provide a single entry of type=criteria with filter conditions.

related_records.description: Related modules whose open record ownership should also be transferred when the parent record is reassigned. Common activity modules (Tasks, Calls, Events) are available for all modules. Additional modules depend on the parent module: Accounts can also include Contacts and Deals; Contacts can also include Deals. Null when no related modules are selected for ownership transfer.

notify.description: Whether to send an email notification to the new owner when the record is reassigned. When true, the newly assigned owner receives an email informing them of the ownership change.

apply_assignment_threshold.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) when assigning ownership. When true, the system checks whether the new owner has reached their record limit before applying the assignment. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

items.description: Availability criterion. Currently only "online_status" is supported - restricts to users currently logged in to Zoho CRM web interface.

user_availability_based_on.description: Restricts assignment to users who are currently available. When set to ["online_status"], only users logged in to the Zoho CRM web interface are eligible for assignment. If the selected user is offline, the assignment is skipped or deferred. Null means no availability check is applied.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this assign owner action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST or PUT requests.

AutomationAssignOwnerDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for assign_owner action. Assigns/reassigns record owner via user, role, group, profile, assignment_rule, merge_field, or criteria. MANDATORY: module ({api_name, id} - must match trigger module), assign_to (array 1-5 entries). OPTIONAL: notify (bool), related_records ([{api_name, id}] - Tasks/Calls/Events), apply_assignment_threshold (bool), user_availability_based_on, lookup_field (for cross-module). EXAMPLE: {"module": {"api_name": "Leads", "id": "111111000000000175"}, "assign_to": [{"type": "user", "resource": {"id": "111111000000050001", "name": "John"}}], "notify": true}
AutomationAssignOwnerDetails.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='assign_owner'. assign_to array (1-5 entries) discriminates on type field: user/role/group/profile/assignment_rule require resource.id; merge_field requires details.api_name (user-type lookup field); criteria requires a criteria array evaluated at runtime. Optional: notify (bool), related_records (transfer child ownership), apply_assignment_threshold (bool). Module reference required.

workflow_rules_AutomationLayoutRef.title: Automation Layout Reference

id.description: Unique layout ID. Required. Obtain from GET /settings/layouts?module={module_api_name}.

name.description: Display name of the layout. Optional in requests; present in GET responses.

display_label.description: Human-readable label of the layout. Present in GET responses.

workflow_rules_AutomationLayoutRef.description: PURPOSE: Layout reference for create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call actions. MANDATORY: id (string). Determines field availability and validation rules. GET /settings/layouts?module={api_name} to discover.
workflow_rules_AutomationLayoutRef.x-zs-llm-description: Layout reference for create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call. id is mandatory  determines which fields are available and required for the target module. Obtain from getLayouts?module={api_name}. Wrong layout returns INVALID_DATA.

workflow_rules_AutomationFieldAttributes.title: Automation Field Attributes

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the target field in the destination module — for example, Subject, Due_Date, or Owner — used to identify the field receiving the mapped value within automation actions such as workflow tasks, create_record, and convert.

id.description: Represents the numeric identifier of the target CRM field. Used in conjunction with the field's API name, both of which must resolve to the same field for a mapping to be valid.

workflow_rules_AutomationFieldAttributes.description: Identifies the target CRM field to which a mapping value is applied within an automation rule. The api_name and ID properties must both be supplied and must refer to the same field; a mismatch between the two causes an AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING error. Available fields for a given module can be discovered via GET /settings/fields?module={api_name}.
workflow_rules_AutomationFieldAttributes.x-zs-llm-description: Target field identifier. Both api_name and id are mandatory  providing only one still works but both should be given for reliability. If both provided and they refer to different fields: AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING. Obtain from getFields?module={module_api_name}. The field must be writable and compatible with mapping type.

workflow_rules_StaticStringValue.description: Represents a plain string value used as the static value for text, picklist, phone, email, URL, number, decimal, currency, and percentage fields. Numeric values are expressed as strings rather than numeric literals. Picklist values must exactly match one of the options defined for the field.
workflow_rules_StaticStringValue.x-zs-llm-description: String value for type=static mappings. Applies to: text, picklist, phone, email, URL, number, decimal, currency, percentage fields. Numbers must be sent as strings (e.g., '100' not 100). Picklist values must match available options  invalid values return INVALID_DATA.

items.description: A single picklist option string to include in the multi-select field value. Each entry corresponds to one selectable option as defined for the target field in Zoho CRM.

workflow_rules_StaticArrayValue.description: Represents an array of string values used as the static value for multiselectpicklist fields, where each element corresponds to an available picklist option. Valid option labels are retrievable from the GET /settings/fields endpoint filtered by data_type=multiselectpicklist.
workflow_rules_StaticArrayValue.x-zs-llm-description: Array value for type=static on multiselect_picklist fields. Each element must match an available picklist option. Discover valid options from getFields for the target module. Invalid options return INVALID_DATA.

workflow_rules_StaticObjectValue.title: Static Object Value

id.description: The system identifier of the referenced entity, such as a user or layout record. This value drives entity resolution by the automation engine and must be provided when the target field references an entity.

name.description: The display name of the referenced entity, such as a user full name or a layout label. When omitted from a request payload, the server resolves and populates this property from the supplied ID. The property is present in all GET responses.

workflow_rules_StaticObjectValue.description: Represents an object value used as the static value for ownerlookup and layout fields, containing an ID that identifies the target user or layout and an optional name that the server resolves from the ID when not supplied. Typically used to assign record ownership by providing the user ID.
workflow_rules_StaticObjectValue.x-zs-llm-description: Object value for type=static on ownerlookup and layout fields. id is mandatory (user ID or layout ID). name is optional server resolves from id. Use getUsers for owner IDs, getLayouts for layout IDs.

workflow_rules_StaticFieldMapping.title: Static Field Mapping

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

type.description: Identifies the mapping strategy for this field assignment. The value must be `static`, which instructs the automation engine to assign a fixed, literal value to the target field at execution time rather than resolving it dynamically.

value.description: The literal value assigned to the target field at automation execution time. The expected shape is determined by the target field data_type, discoverable via GET /settings/fields?module={module}. For most field types, supply a string (for example, "High", "Not Started", "1234"). For multi-select picklist fields (data_type: multiselectpicklist), supply an array of option strings. For fields that reference an entity such as an owner or layout (data_type: ownerlookup), supply an object with at minimum the entity ID.

workflow_rules_StaticFieldMapping.description: Represents a static-type mapping that assigns a literal value directly to the target field at execution time. The value shape varies by field data type: a plain string for text, picklist, phone, email, URL, number, decimal, currency, and percentage fields (numeric values expressed as strings); an array of strings for multiselectpicklist fields; and an object containing ID and name for ownerlookup fields. Date, datetime, and ALARM fields do not support this type — use execution_time instead, as static on those fields produces a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error. Fields marked unique in the module settings also require merge_field rather than static for create_record actions.
workflow_rules_StaticFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='static' mapping. Value is used as-is without runtime resolution. NOT for Date/DateTime/ALARM fields (use execution_time  static returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). NOT for unique fields or formula fields. Value structure depends on field data_type: string for most fields, array for multiselect_picklist, object for ownerlookup/layout.

workflow_rules_MergeFieldStringValue.description: Represents the string value carried by a merge_field mapping, containing one or more runtime-resolved token references. Supports direct field tokens (${!Module.Field}), lookup traversal tokens (${!Module.Lookup.Field}), and system tokens (${CURRENTTIME}, ${CURRENTUSER}). Tokens may be combined with surrounding text for multi-line field targets. Fields that hold a single typed value such as email or URL accept exactly one token.
workflow_rules_MergeFieldStringValue.x-zs-llm-description: String containing merge-field tokens for type=merge_field mappings. Resolved at runtime. Formats: ${!Module.Field} (direct access), ${!Module.Lookup.Field} (traverse lookup). Multiple tokens can be combined in one string. Unsupported tokens return UNSUPPORTED_MERGE_FIELD error.

workflow_rules_MergeFieldMapping.title: Merge Field Mapping

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

type.description: Identifies the mapping strategy for this field assignment. The value must be `merge_field`, which instructs the automation engine to resolve the field value dynamically from a merge field token at execution time rather than from a static literal.

allow_agent_user.description:
Controls whether agent users are eligible for record assignment. Possible values:
**true** — agent users are included in the assignment pool alongside standard users.
**false** — agent users are excluded from assignment.
Applies to mapping types role, group, profile, merge_field, and criteria. Does not apply to user or assignment_rule types.

workflow_rules_MergeFieldMapping.description: Represents a merge_field-type mapping whose value is resolved at execution time by substituting token references with live field data. Supports direct field tokens (${!Module.Field}), traversal tokens (${!Module.Lookup.Field}), and system tokens (${CURRENTTIME}, ${CURRENTUSER}). Applies to text-based fields such as Subject, Description, and custom text fields. Targeting owner or lookup fields with this type produces a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error; those fields require a static mapping using an object with a numeric identifier and an optional name. Multiple tokens may be chained with surrounding text for multi-line fields, while single-value fields such as email or URL accept exactly one token.
workflow_rules_MergeFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='merge_field' mapping. Value contains ${!Module.Field} tokens resolved at execution time. ONLY for text-based fields (Subject, Description, etc.)  using on date/number/picklist fields returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Supports lookup traversal: ${!Module.Lookup.Field}. Multi-module not supported.

workflow_rules_ExecutionTimeValue.title: Execution Time Value

period.description:
The calendar or time unit applied to the offset. Possible values:
**days** — counts all calendar days including weekends and holidays; supported by every action type.
**business_days** — excludes weekends and requires the organisation's business-day setting to be enabled; supported by all action types.
**hours** — available only for create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call.
**minutes** — available only for create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call.
workflow_tasks accept only **days** or **business_days**.

unit.description: The number of period units to offset from the trigger date, supplied as a non-negative integer string (for example, "1", "30"). Passing "0" produces a same-day result, such as scheduling a Remind_At on the same day as the due date.

sign.description:
The direction of the offset relative to the trigger date. Possible values:
**plus** — places the computed value after the trigger (for example, a due date two days after record creation).
**minus** — places the computed value before the trigger (for example, a reminder one day before the due date).
For datetime fields (data_type=datetime) a value is expected; omitting it returns a DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error. For date-only fields (data_type=date) the value defaults to **plus** when absent. When targeting Remind_At (data_type=ALARM), **minus** is the only applicable direction.

trigger_field.description: The reference date or datetime field from which the offset is measured. Accepts a merge-field token that resolves to a Date or DateTime field on the parent module (for example, "${!Leads.Modified_Time}", "${!Tasks.Due_Date}"), or the reserved constant "${CURRENTTIME}" to use the automation execution timestamp. When computing a Remind_At (ALARM) value, "${!Tasks.Due_Date}" is the typical anchor.

time.description: The time-of-day component of the computed value, expressed in 24-hour HH:mm format (for example, "13:00", "01:30"). Applies when the target field carries data type datetime or ALARM (as reported by GET /settings/fields). Supplying this property for a date-only field (data_type=date) produces a validation error.

notify_type.description:
The notification channel used to deliver the reminder. Applies exclusively when the target field carries data type ALARM (i.e., Remind_At); date and datetime fields do not use this property. Possible values:
**popup** — triggers an in-app notification.
**email** — sends a message to the task owner.
**emailandpopup** — delivers both simultaneously.

workflow_rules_ExecutionTimeValue.description: Represents the offset configuration used by an execution_time mapping to compute a final date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime. Contains period (the time unit granularity), unit (the numeric magnitude expressed as a string integer), and trigger_field (a merge token or ${CURRENTTIME}). Date fields use period, unit, and trigger_field with an implied positive direction. Datetime fields additionally accept sign to control direction. ALARM fields additionally accept time and notify_type, and always require a minus sign. Workflow task actions restrict period to days or business_days.
workflow_rules_ExecutionTimeValue.x-zs-llm-description: Offset computation object for date/datetime/ALARM fields. Required fields: period ('days'|'hours'|'minutes'), unit (string integer  quantity), trigger_field (merge-field token like ${!Leads.Created_Time} or ${CURRENTTIME}). Optional: sign ('positive' for after, 'negative' for before  default varies by context). Missing required fields return DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING.

workflow_rules_ExecutionTimeFieldMapping.title: Execution Time Field Mapping

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

type.description: Identifies the mapping variant as an execution-time offset. The value is always "execution_time" for this schema and acts as the polymorphic discriminator across the AutomationFieldMappings union.

workflow_rules_ExecutionTimeFieldMapping.description: Represents an execution_time-type field mapping that computes a date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime by applying a signed offset to a trigger field or the current time. The value carries an ExecutionTimeValue object specifying the period, unit, trigger_field, and optional time or notify_type properties. A plus sign places the result after the trigger; a minus sign places it before. ALARM fields always require minus. Workflow task actions support only days and business_days as period values.
workflow_rules_ExecutionTimeFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='execution_time' mapping. REQUIRED for Date, DateTime, and ALARM field types (static/merge_field on these returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). Computes value as offset from trigger_field. Value object needs: period ('days'|'hours'|'minutes'), unit (integer as string), trigger_field (merge token or ${CURRENTTIME}), sign (for before/after offset).

workflow_rules_CompositeFieldMapping.title: Composite Field Mapping

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

type.description: Serves as the polymorphic discriminator that identifies this field mapping as a composite mapping; the value must be set to "composite" to select this schema variant.

value.description: Holds the structured composite object that encodes participant data for the Events module Participants field; the shape of this object varies according to the participant type configuration defined for the automation rule.

workflow_rules_CompositeFieldMapping.description: Represents a composite-type field mapping used exclusively for the Participants field in the Events module via the add_meeting action. The value carries a structured object that encodes participant data and is not applicable to any other field or automation action type.
workflow_rules_CompositeFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='composite' mapping. Used ONLY for the Participants field in Events module (add_meeting action). Value is a structured object representing multiple participant entries. Cannot be used on other field types  returns NOT_ALLOWED.

workflow_rules_AutomationFieldMappings.title: Automation Field Mappings
workflow_rules_AutomationFieldMappings.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping used within automation actions such as workflow tasks, create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call. Each mapping identifies a target field via api_name or ID, declares a type discriminator that determines value interpretation, and supplies a value whose shape varies by type: static supplies a literal value, merge_field supplies a runtime-resolved token string, execution_time supplies a date or datetime offset object, and composite supplies structured participant data for the Events Participants field. The field_mappings array must include all fields the target module requires; omitting any produces a REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND error.
workflow_rules_AutomationFieldMappings.x-zs-llm-description: A single field-to-value mapping entry used in create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call, convert, and workflow task actions. Each entry targets one field and assigns a typed value. The type field discriminates the value structure: static (literal), merge_field (runtime token), execution_time (date offset), composite (multi-value). field identifies the target, type selects the value schema, value provides the data.

AutomationCreateRecordDetails.title: Automation Create Record Details

field_mappings.description: Field mappings for the new record. Each entry: {"field": {"api_name": "Last_Name"}, "type": "static", "value": "Test"}. Must include all mandatory fields (system_mandatory=true or api_mandatory=true from GET /settings/layouts?module={module}) - missing ones cause REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND. Mapping types: static - literal values for text, picklist, phone, number fields; NOT for Date/DateTime/ALARM (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH) or unique fields (INVALID_DATA, check unique=true in GET /settings/fields). merge_field - runtime tokens like ${!Leads.Company} for text-based fields; NOT for lookup/owner fields (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). execution_time - REQUIRED for Date/DateTime/ALARM fields; periods: days, business_days, hours, minutes; sign required for datetime fields.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the record owner when creating the record. When true, the system checks whether the owner has reached their record limit before creating the record. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this create record action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

AutomationCreateRecordDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for create_record action. Creates a record in a module with field values from static data, merge fields, or execution-time refs. NOT for Tasks/Events/Calls (use tasks, add_meeting, schedule_call). PREREQUISITES: GET /settings/modules for id. GET /settings/layouts?module={api_name} for layout + mandatory fields. GET /settings/fields?module={api_name} for field ids. MANDATORY: module ({api_name, id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include all mandatory fields). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool). EXAMPLE: {"module": {"api_name": "Contacts", "id": "111111000000000129"}, "layout": {"id": "111111000000000403"}, "field_mappings": [{"field": {"api_name": "Last_Name"}, "type": "merge_field", "value": "${!Leads.Last_Name}"}]}
AutomationCreateRecordDetails.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='create_record'. Creates a record in a module (NOT Tasks/Events/Calls  use dedicated action types). Requires module ({api_name, id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (1-25 entries covering all mandatory fields). Each mapping has field reference, type (static|merge_field|execution_time|composite), and typed value. Optional: apply_restriction (bool).

api_name.description: Module API name.

id.description: Module ID.

module.description: REQUIRED. Target child module for connected record creation. Must be a valid connected-record child module of the rule's module. Use GET /settings/modules to discover api_name and id.

field_mappings.description: REQUIRED. Field mapping array (1-25 entries). Use GET /settings/fields?module={api_name} to discover field api_name and id. All mandatory fields for the target module/layout must be included.

id.description: Read-only. Unique identifier for the action.

AutomationCreateConnectedRecordDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for create_connected_record action. Same as create_record but module must be a connected-record child of the rule's module. Requires ManageAutomation or ManageConnectedWorkflow permission. Not for Notes, Rebuy, Competitor Mentions. Limit: 1/rule. MANDATORY: module ({api_name, id} of child), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include all mandatory fields). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool).
AutomationCreateConnectedRecordDetails.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='create_connected_record'. Same structure as create_record but module must be a connected-record child. Requires module, layout, field_mappings. Not for Notes, Rebuy, or Competitor Mentions. Requires ManageAutomation or ManageConnectedWorkflow permission. Limit 1/rule.

AutomationMeetingDuration.title: Automation Meeting Duration

period.description: The time unit for the duration. "hours" - duration in hours (e.g., unit=1, period=hours means a 1-hour meeting). "minutes" - duration in minutes (e.g., unit=30, period=minutes means a 30-minute meeting).

AutomationMeetingDuration.description: PURPOSE: Meeting duration for add_meeting. MANDATORY unless All_Day=true. REQUIRED: unit (integer - quantity), period (string - 'hours' or 'minutes'). Must be a JSON object (not int/string - INVALID_DATA). Omitting returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND. If All_Day=true and provided, returns INVALID_DATA (field1/field2 conflict). EXAMPLE: {"unit": 1, "period": "hours"}
AutomationMeetingDuration.x-zs-llm-description: Duration config for add_meeting. Required when All_Day is not true. unit is the quantity (integer), period is the time unit ('hours', 'minutes', or 'days'). Omit entirely when mapping All_Day=true (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH if both present).

AutomationHostUnavailable.title: Automation Host Unavailable

assign_record_owner_as_host.description: When true, the record owner is automatically assigned as the host/caller if the originally designated host is unavailable. Mutually exclusive with assign_task.

name.description: Name of the follow-up task.

id.description: Unique ID of the pre-configured task.

assign_task.description: A follow-up task to create when the host is unavailable. Mutually exclusive with assign_record_owner_as_host. The task must be pre-configured in the CRM.

AutomationHostUnavailable.description: PURPOSE: Fallback when meeting host or caller is unavailable. Exactly ONE must be specified: assign_record_owner_as_host (bool) OR assign_task ({id}). Both = INVALID_DATA. Neither = EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING.
AutomationHostUnavailable.x-zs-llm-description: Fallback config when the meeting host or caller is unavailable. Exactly ONE option must be set: assign_record_owner_as_host (bool  record owner becomes host) OR assign_task ({id}  delegates to an existing task entity). Setting both or neither returns INVALID_DATA.

AutomationAddMeetingDetails.title: Automation Add Meeting Details

field_mappings.description: Field mappings for the new Event. Each entry: {"field": {"api_name": "Event_Title"}, "type": "static", "value": "Meeting"}. Must include all mandatory fields from GET /settings/layouts?module=Events. Common fields: Event_Title, Start_DateTime, All_Day, Participants (composite type), Remind_At. End_DateTime is auto-computed from Start_DateTime + meeting_duration - do NOT provide it. Mapping types: static - literal values for text, picklist fields; NOT for DateTime/ALARM (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). merge_field - runtime tokens like ${!Leads.Company} for text-based fields; NOT for lookup/owner (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). execution_time - REQUIRED for Start_DateTime and Remind_At; sign required for datetime; periods: days, business_days, hours, minutes. When All_Day=true, period must be "days" and omit meeting_duration.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the record owner when creating the Event record. When true, the system checks whether the owner has reached their record limit before creating the record. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this add meeting action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

AutomationAddMeetingDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for add_meeting action. Creates an Event record when workflow fires. PREREQUISITES: GET /settings/layouts?module=Events for layout + mandatory fields. GET /settings/fields?module=Events for field ids. MANDATORY: module ({api_name: 'Events', id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include Event_Title, Start_DateTime), meeting_duration ({unit: int, period: 'hours'|'minutes'} - NOT when All_Day=true), host_unavailable ({assign_record_owner_as_host: true} or {assign_task: {id}}). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool).
AutomationAddMeetingDetails.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='add_meeting'. Creates an Event record. Requires module (Events), layout, field_mappings (must include Event_Title, Start_DateTime), meeting_duration ({unit, period}  omit when All_Day=true), host_unavailable (exactly one of: assign_record_owner_as_host=true OR assign_task={id}). Optional: apply_restriction.

workflow_rules_AutomationScheduleCallDet.title: Automation Schedule Call Details

field_mappings.description: Field mappings for the new Call. Each entry: {"field": {"api_name": "Subject"}, "type": "static", "value": "Follow-up"}. Must include all mandatory fields from GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls. Call_Type is system-mandatory (values: "Outbound", "Inbound", "Missed") - omitting returns REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND. Common fields: Subject, Call_Type, Call_Purpose, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At. Mapping types: static - literal values for text, picklist fields; NOT for DateTime/ALARM (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). merge_field - runtime tokens like ${!Leads.Phone} for text-based fields; NOT for lookup/owner (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). execution_time - REQUIRED for Call_Start_Time and Remind_At; sign required for datetime; periods: days, business_days, hours, minutes.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the record owner when creating the Call record. When true, the system checks whether the owner has reached their record limit before creating the record. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this schedule call action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

workflow_rules_AutomationScheduleCallDet.description: PURPOSE: Details object for schedule_call action. Creates a Call record when workflow fires. PREREQUISITES: GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls for layout + mandatory fields. GET /settings/fields?module=Calls for field ids. MANDATORY: module ({api_name: 'Calls', id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include Subject, Call_Type). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool). KEY FIELDS: Subject, Call_Type ('Outbound'|'Inbound'|'Missed'), Call_Purpose, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At.
workflow_rules_AutomationScheduleCallDet.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='schedule_call'. Creates a Calls record. Requires module (Calls), layout, field_mappings (must include Subject). Key fields: Subject, Call_Purpose, Call_Type, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At. Same field_mapping structure as create_record. Optional: apply_restriction.

AutomationTagRef.title: Automation Tag Reference

id.description: Unique identifier of the tag. Obtain from GET /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. If provided alone, the tag is resolved by ID. If both id and name are provided, they must resolve to the same tag.

name.description: Name of the tag. Obtain from GET /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. If provided alone, the tag is resolved by name. Must match an existing tag  - providing a non-existent name returns INVALID_DATA. Max 25 characters, cannot contain <, >, commas, or emojis.

color_code.description: Hex color code of the tag (e.g., '#879BFC'). Optional in requests; present in GET responses. Allowed values: #F17574, #F48435, #E7A826, #A8C026, #63C57E, #1DB9B4, #57B1FD, #879BFC, #D297EE, #FD87BD, #969696, #658BA8, #B88562.

AutomationTagRef.description: PURPOSE: Tag reference for add_tags/remove_tags. Tags must pre-exist - GET /settings/tags?module={api_name} to list, POST to create. MANDATORY: id, name. Both must resolve to same tag (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING if mismatch). Non-existent = INVALID_DATA. Limits: 100 tags/module, 10 tags/record, name max 25 chars.
AutomationTagRef.x-zs-llm-description: Tag reference for add_tags/remove_tags. Both id and name are mandatory  missing either returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND. Tags must pre-exist. Discover via getTags?module={api_name}, create via POST /settings/tags. Invalid tag id returns INVALID_DATA.

AutomationAddTagsDetails.title: Automation Add Tags Details

over_write.description: Whether to overwrite all existing tags on the record with the specified tags (true) or append to existing tags (false). Default is false. When set to true, any RemoveTags action in the same workflow rule becomes invalid and returns INVALID_DATA ('Remove tag not supported with Overwrite Add Tag').

tags.description: List of tags to add to the record. All tags must pre-exist in the org  - fetch available tags from GET /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. To create new tags: POST /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. If the list is empty after parsing, the API returns FAILURE ('Empty Tag'). If the tag count exceeds the edition limit, the API returns FAILURE ('Invalid Tag Count').

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this add tags action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

AutomationAddTagsDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for add_tags action. Adds pre-existing tags to the triggering record. PREREQUISITES: Tags must exist - GET /settings/tags?module={api_name} to list, POST to create first. MANDATORY: tags (array 1-10, each {id, name}). OPTIONAL: over_write (bool, default false - true replaces ALL existing tags), module ({api_name, id}). CONSTRAINTS: Not allowed with convert on Leads (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING). over_write=true + remove_tags in same rule = INVALID_DATA. Unsupported: Visits, Users, LinkingModules (NOT_ALLOWED).
AutomationAddTagsDetails.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='add_tags'. Requires tags array (1-10, each {id, name}). Optional: over_write (true replaces all existing tags), module ({api_name, id}). Cannot coexist with convert on Leads. over_write=true + remove_tags in same rule = INVALID_DATA. Tags must pre-exist  discover via getTags or create via POST.

AutomationRemoveTagsDetails.title: Automation Remove Tags Details

tags.description: List of tags to remove from the record. All tags must pre-exist in the org  - fetch available tags from GET /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. If the list is empty after parsing, the API returns FAILURE ('Empty Tag'). If the tag count exceeds the edition limit, the API returns FAILURE ('Invalid Tag Count').

over_write.description: Present in GET responses. Its value is ignored for remove_tags actions.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this remove tags action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST or PUT requests.

For Leads conversion: Events, Calls, Tasks, Contacts, Deals are valid. For Quotes/SalesOrders conversion: only Events, Calls, Tasks are valid.

apply_assignment_threshold.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the new owner for each converted module. When true, the system checks whether the new owner has reached their record limit before assigning ownership.

AutomationConvertChangeOwner.description: PURPOSE: Owner assignment during convert action. MANDATORY: id (user ID from GET /users). OPTIONAL: name, related_modules ([{api_name, id}] - which converted modules get new owner), apply_assignment_threshold (bool). For Leads: related_modules can include Events, Calls, Tasks, Contacts, Deals.

AutomationConvertDetails.title: Automation Convert Details

add_to_existing_contact.description: MANDATORY for Leads conversion (omitting returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND). Whether to link the converted record to an existing Contact instead of creating a new one. Only applicable for Leads module. When true, if a matching Contact exists (based on duplicate-check criteria), the Lead is merged into it rather than creating a new Contact. Not applicable for Quotes or Sales_Orders conversions.

add_to_existing_account.description: MANDATORY for Leads conversion (omitting returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND). Whether to link the converted record to an existing Account instead of creating a new one. Only applicable for Leads module. When true, if a matching Account exists (based on Company name), the Lead is linked to it rather than creating a new Account. Not applicable for Quotes or Sales_Orders conversions.

carry_tags.description: List of target modules that should inherit tags from the source record during conversion. For Leads: may include Contacts, Accounts, Deals. Each entry identifies a module by api_name and/or id.

field_mappings.description: List of field-value pairs to populate in the converted record(s). Each entry maps a target field to a value using one of the supported types: static, merge_field, or execution_time. For Leads conversion, field mappings can target Contacts, Accounts, and Deals modules. Fetch available fields from GET /settings/fields?module={target_module_api_name}.

create_deal.description: Whether to create a Deal record as part of Leads conversion. Only applicable when the trigger module is Leads. When true, the Deal module field mappings in field_mappings are used to populate the new Deal.

contact_role.description: Unique ID of the Contact Role to assign when a Deal is created during Leads conversion. Only applicable when create_deal=true. Obtain valid Contact Role IDs from GET /Contacts/roles.

api_name.description: API name of the target module. For Quotes: 'SalesOrders' or 'Invoices'. For Sales_Orders: 'Invoices'.

id.description: Unique 19-digit module ID of the target module. Obtain from GET /settings/modules. Always use the full 19-digit ID as returned by the API; truncated IDs cause INVALID_DATA.

convert_to.description: MANDATORY for Quotes and Sales_Orders conversion (omitting returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND). Identifies the target module for conversion as an object with api_name and id. For Quotes: convert_to can be {api_name: 'SalesOrders', id: '<module_id>'} or {api_name: 'Invoices', id: '<module_id>'}. For Sales_Orders: convert_to must be {api_name: 'Invoices', id: '<module_id>'}. Obtain the module id from GET /settings/modules. Not applicable for Leads conversion (Leads always convert to Contacts+Accounts, optionally +Deals).

id.description: Unique identifier of the portal user type. Must match an existing portal user type in the org's portal configuration.

name.description: Display name of the portal user type.

portal_user_type.description: Portal user type to assign during Leads conversion. Only applicable when the org has portals configured and the converted Contact should be provisioned as a portal user. The id and name must match an existing portal user type - validated against the org's portal metadata (CrmClientPortalFilterUtil). Not applicable for Quotes or Sales_Orders conversions.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules on the record owner during conversion. Present in GET responses.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this convert action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

AutomationConvertDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for convert action. Converts records - Leads to Contacts+Accounts+Deals, Quotes to SalesOrders/Invoices, SalesOrders to Invoices. PREREQUISITES: criteria_details.criteria MUST be non-null (NOT_ALLOWED otherwise). Module MUST be Leads/Quotes/Sales_Orders. MANDATORY (Leads): add_to_existing_contact (bool), add_to_existing_account (bool). MANDATORY (Quotes/Sales_Orders): convert_to ({api_name, id}). OPTIONAL: change_owner, carry_tags (ARRAY [{api_name, id}] NOT boolean), field_mappings (max 25), move_attachment_to, create_deal (Leads only), contact_role (with create_deal). CONSTRAINTS: No add_tags/remove_tags with convert on Leads. No scheduled actions with convert.
AutomationConvertDetails.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='convert'. Converts records across modules (Leads→Contacts+Accounts+Deals, Quotes→SalesOrders/Invoices, SalesOrders→Invoices). Limit 1/rule. For Leads: add_to_existing_contact, add_to_existing_account, change_owner mandatory. For Quotes/SalesOrders: convert_to required. Optional: create_deal, carry_tags (array not boolean), field_mappings, move_attachment_to, contact_role. No scheduled actions allowed alongside convert.

TaskCreateOrUpdateInput.title: Task Create Or Update Input

name.description: Display name for this task definition. Must be identical to the value provided in the Subject field_mapping entry. If they do not match, the API returns INVALID_DATA. For merge_field type Subject mappings, set name to the same token string (e.g., "${!Leads.Last_Name}").

notify.description: Whether notification should be sent to the task owner when this automation task executes.

feature_type.description: The automation feature this task definition belongs to. Defaults to "workflow" if omitted. A task can only be associated with the feature it was created for - a task with feature_type="workflow" can only be attached to workflow rules, not to blueprints or kiosks. Supported values are defined in the enum.

field_mappings.description: REQUIRED. Field mappings for task fields. Mandatory mappings: Subject (static or merge_field), Due_Date (execution_time), Status (static: Not Started, Deferred, In Progress, Completed, Waiting on someone else), Priority (static: Highest, High, Normal, Low, Lowest). Optional: Description, Owner, Remind_At (execution_time). Each entry requires field ({api_name, id}), type, and value. Types: static (literal values), merge_field (${!Module.Field} tokens), execution_time (for Date/DateTime/ALARM - requires period, unit, trigger_field, sign). Workflow tasks support period: days, business_days only. Max 20 entries.

TaskCreateOrUpdateInput.description: PURPOSE: Writable task fields for create or update. PREREQUISITES: (1) Call GET /settings/layouts?module=Tasks - fields with required: true in the field info are mandatory in field_mappings. (2) Call GET /settings/modules to discover valid module api_names. Read-only fields (id, created_time, modified_time, created_by, modified_by, lock_status, associated, deletable) are excluded.
TaskCreateOrUpdateInput.x-zs-llm-description: Describes the editable fields for a task definition. System-managed fields (id, created_time, modified_time, created_by, modified_by, lock_status, associated, deletable) must not be included.
